about: The first studio album by American singer-songwriter Michelle Shocked, issued by Mercury Records in August 1988 and produced by Pete Anderson. Blending folk with punk energy, it followed her live Texas Campfire Tapes and gave her a US chart single with Anchorage.

title: Greetings From Asbury Park, N.J.
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Bruce Springsteen – lead vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, piano, keyboards Clarence Clemons – saxophone, vocals Vini Lopez – drums, vocals David Sancious – piano, Hammond organ, keyboards Garry Tallent – bass

tracks.t: Does This Bus Stop At 82nd Street?
It's Hard To Be A Saint In The City

about: Bruce Springsteen's first album, released by Columbia Records in January 1973 after sessions at 914 Sound Studios in New York state, produced by Mike Appel and Jim Cretecos. Sales were modest but reviews were favourable; its singles Blinded by the Light and Spirit in the Night did not chart.

title: Hotel California
label: Asylum Records
personnel: Don Felder – guitars, backing vocals, pedal steel (on The Last Resort) Glenn Frey – guitars, backing vocals, keyboards, lead vocals Don Henley – drums, percussion, lead vocals, backing vocals, synthesizer Randy Meisner – bass, backing vocals, lead vocals, guitarrón Joe Walsh – guitars, keyboards, backing vocals, lead vocals

tracks.t: Pretty Maids All In A Row

about: The fifth studio album by American rock band the Eagles, issued on Asylum Records in December 1976 with Bill Szymczyk producing. It introduced Joe Walsh and was Randy Meisner's last with the group, topped the Billboard 200, and its title song won the Grammy for Record of the Year.

title: Peace And Love - Wadadasow
label: Wild Flower
personnel: Ras Michael - vocals Lloyd Parks - bass Federal Soul Givers - brass Paul Williams - drums Willie Lindo - guitar Lloyd Charmers - organ, percussion, piano
about: The only album released under the Dadawah name, a moniker used by Ras Michael of the Sons of Negus, first issued in 1974 on the Wild Flower label and later reissued by Dug Out. Its four long tracks pair Nyahbinghi drumming with dub-heavy bass and echo-soaked guitar in a devotional Rastafarian setting.

title: Java Java Java Java
label: Impact!
personnel: V. "Tony" Chin, T. Valentine, Rad Bryan, E. "Chinna" Smith Fully Fullwood, Lloyd Parks, E. "Santa" Davis Horace "Augustus Pablo" Swaby, A. "Family Man" Barrett Tyrone "Organ D" Downie, Winston Wright, Tommy MC Cook, Tony King Clive Chin
about: An instrumental dub set from 1973 made up of stripped-down versions of reggae rhythms, recorded at Randy's Studio in Kingston with engineering by Errol Thompson and Clive Chin. Only around 500 copies were pressed originally, and it was later reissued by 17 North Parade/VP Records.

title: Paul Simon
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: Me And Julio Down By The Schoolyard

about: Paul Simon's second solo studio album, released by Columbia Records in January 1972, roughly two years after Simon and Garfunkel split. The folk rock and pop set draws on Latin, jazz, blues and reggae styles, reached number four in the US and topped the charts in the UK, Japan and Norway.

title: Possum Head
label: Argo Records
personnel: Lou Donaldson - alto saxophone Bill Hardman - trumpet
Ray Crawford - guitar Big John Patton - organ
Ben Dixon - drums Cleopas "Mopedido" Morris - percussion
about: A studio album by American jazz saxophonist Lou Donaldson, recorded on 28 January 1964 and issued that year by Argo Records. It sits among the run of soul jazz records he made as a leader during the early and mid 1960s.

title: Toxicity
label: American Recordings
personnel: Serj Tankian – vocals, keyboards, guitar Daron Malakian – guitars, sitar, vocals Shavo Odadjian – bass John Dolmayan – drums
about: The second studio album by Armenian-American metal band System of a Down, released in September 2001 by American Recordings and Columbia, produced by Rick Rubin and Daron Malakian. It brought more melody and harmony plus folk and Armenian influences, reached number one in the US and Canada, and went seven times platinum.

title: Sufferer
label: Antarctica Starts Here
personnel: Cebert "Jackie" Bernard Lloyd "Footy" Bernard Lloyd Kerr
about: The only album the Jamaican vocal trio the Kingstonians issued while active, released by Trojan Records in 1970 and reissued in later decades. It collects rocksteady and early reggae material the group recorded with producer Derrick Harriott.

title: A Night At The Opera
label: Warner Bros Records
personnel: Freddie Mercury – vocals, piano Brian May – guitar, vocals, koto, harp, ukulele Roger Taylor – drums, vocals, percussion, electric guitar John Deacon – bass, electric piano, double bass

tracks.t: I'm In Love With My Car

about: The fourth studio album by British rock band Queen, released in November 1975 on EMI and Elektra and named after a Marx Brothers film. Reportedly the costliest album made up to that time, it topped the UK chart, became their first US platinum record and contains Bohemian Rhapsody.

title: Rasta Ambassador
label: Virgin Records
personnel: Sly Dunbar, Stickie - drums. Albert (Gladiator) Griffiths, Ranchie, Duggie - guitar
Ansel Collins - piano. Earl (Wire) Lindo - synthesizer. Albert Griffiths, Naggo Morris, The Gladiators, Wayne Jarrett - vocals
about: A 1977 album by U-Roy, the Jamaican deejay credited with popularising toasting over reggae rhythms. It arrived during his productive late-1970s run between Natty Rebel and Jah Son of Africa.

title: Big Band And Quartet In Concert
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Big Band Personnel Nick Travis - Trumpet
Eddie Bert - Trombone Steve Lacy - Soprano sax
Phil Woods - Alto sax, Clarinet Charlie Rouse - Tenor sax
Gene Allen - Baritone sax, Bass Clarinet, Clarinet Quartet Charlie Rouse - Tenor sax
about: A Columbia live album by jazz pianist Thelonious Monk, recorded on 30 December 1963 at Philharmonic Hall in Lincoln Center and released in March 1964 with Teo Macero producing. His quartet is joined by six horn players on large-ensemble arrangements by Hall Overton.

title: Something Else By The Kinks
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Ray Davies – vocals, guitar, harmonica, harp, harpsichord, organ, tuba Dave Davies – guitar, vocals Pete Quaife – bass, vocals Mick Avory – drums, percussion

tracks.t: Love Me Till The Sun Shines

about: The Kinks' fifth studio record, issued in September 1967. It leans toward baroque pop and English music hall styles, and Ray Davies handled most of the production himself for the first time.

title: Speaking In Tongues
label: Sire Records
personnel: David Byrne – vocals, keyboards, guitars, bass , synthesizer, percussion Chris Frantz – drums, backing vocals, synthesizer Jerry Harrison – keyboards, synthesizer, guitars, backing vocals Tina Weymouth – bass guitar, backing vocals, synthesizer, guitar

tracks.t: This Must Be The Place (Naive Melody)

about: The fifth studio album by Talking Heads, released in 1983 and the band's commercial breakthrough. It contained their only US top ten single, Burning Down the House, and its supporting tour, their final one, was captured in the concert film Stop Making Sense.

title: Caught Up
label: Southbound Records

tracks.t: (If Loving You Is Wrong )I Don't Want To Be Right
(If Loving You Is Wrong) I Don't Want To Be Right (Reprise)
All I Want Is A Fighting Chance
It's All Over But The Shouting
I'm Through Trying To Prove My Love To You

about: Millie Jackson's fourth studio album, a 1974 soul concept record about an extramarital affair. The first side presents the story from the mistress's viewpoint, while the second side shifts to the wife's perspective.

title: Pretty Paper
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Willie Nelson – Vocals, guitar Paul English – Drums
Mickey Raphael – Harmonica Bee Spears – Bass

tracks.t: Santa Claus Is Coming To Town

about: A holiday record by Willie Nelson, produced by Booker T. Jones and released in November 1979. It pairs familiar Christmas standards with Nelson's own song Pretty Paper, which gives the album its name.

title: Is Alive And Well At The Whisky
label: UNI Records
personnel: Hugh Masekela - trumpet, vocals Henry Franklin - bass
Chuck Carter - drums Cecil Barnard - piano Al Abreu - saxophone
about: A concert recording by South African trumpeter Hugh Masekela, taped at the Whisky a Go Go in Hollywood in September 1967. It was issued the same year on Uni Records.

title: Cosmo's Factory
label: Fantasy Records
personnel: John Fogerty – lead guitar, lead vocals, piano, electric piano, keyboards, saxophone, harmonica, producer, arranger Tom Fogerty – rhythm guitar, backing vocals Stu Cook – bass guitar, backing vocals Doug Clifford – drums, cowbell

tracks.t: I Heard It Through The Grapevine
Long As I Can See The Light

about: Creedence Clearwater Revival's fifth studio album, released in July 1970. Named after the warehouse where the band rehearsed, it mixes original songs with covers and became one of the group's most commercially successful records.

title: Herbman Hustling
label: Black Roots
personnel: McKitty, Professor Pickney, Tonic Man - bass. Leroy "Horsemouth" Wallace, Sly Dunbar - drums
about: A 1984 release by Jamaican singer Sugar Minott, issued through his own Black Roots label. It belongs to his prolific mid-1980s output, when he was a leading figure bridging roots reggae and the emerging dancehall style.

title: Mack The Knife - Ella In Berlin
label: WaxTime Records
personnel: Ella Fitzgerald – vocals Paul Smith – piano Jim Hall – guitar Wilfred Middlebrooks – double bass Gus Johnson – drums

tracks.t: Our Love Is Here To Stay

about: Concert recording made by Ella Fitzgerald at Berlin's Deutschlandhalle in February 1960 and issued by Verve. Her improvised take on Mack the Knife, sung after she lost track of the words, earned Grammy awards, and the record later entered the Grammy Hall of Fame.

title: Silk Electric
label: RCA Records
about: Diana Ross's 1982 RCA album, mostly self-produced, blending R&B and pop soul. Michael Jackson wrote and produced its lead single Muscles, a US top-ten hit. The record went gold in the United States and silver in Britain.

title: Electrified Funk
label: Epic
personnel: Robert Parissi - lead guitar, lead vocals Allen Wentz - bass guitar, synthesizer, vocals Ronald Beitle - drums, vocals Mark Avsec - keyboards Bryan Bassett - lead guitar, vocals

tracks.t: Are You Boogieing Around On Your Daddy

about: Second record by Ohio funk rock group Wild Cherry, produced by Rob Parissi for Epic. Its single Baby Don't You Know served as a sequel to their earlier smash hit and charted in the Billboard Hot 100 top fifty.

title: Keep On Jumpin'
label: Prelude Records
personnel: Patrick Adams Christine Wiltshire, Angela Howell, Gina Taylor Pickens, Mary Seymour Williams and Jocelyn Brown - vocals
about: First album by Musique, a New York disco studio project led by producer Patrick Adams and released on Prelude. Its four tracks include In the Bush and the title song, both of which reached the top of the US dance charts.

title: Love To The World
label: A&M Records
personnel: Jeffrey Osborne - Vocals, Drums, Percussion Billy Osborne - Clavinet, Organ, Piano, Synthesizer, Vocals Jimmie Davis - Clavinet, Electric Piano, Piano, Vocals Henry Davis - Bass
Bernorce Blackman, John McGee - Guitar Carle Vickers - Flute, Flugelhorn, Soprano Sax, Trumpet Abraham "Onion" Miller - Tenor Sax, Vocals
about: Soul and funk set by L.T.D., produced by the Mizell brothers for A&M. It contains Love Ballad, which topped the soul singles chart, and reached the R&B albums top ten.

title: One Step Closer
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Patrick Simmons – guitars, lead and backing vocals John McFee – guitars, backing vocals Michael McDonald – keyboards, synthesizers, lead and backing vocals Cornelius Bumpus – tenor saxophone, soprano saxophone, organ, vocals Tiran Porter – bass
Keith Knudsen – drums, backing vocals Chet McCracken – drums, vibraphone, marimbas
about: Doobie Brothers album produced by Ted Templeman for Warner Bros. It climbed to number three in the US, featured the top-five single Real Love, and was the group's final studio record before their 1982 split.

title: I Told You So
label: Colemine Records
personnel: Delvon Lamarr (Dumas) - Hammond B-3 organ David McGraw - drums Jimmy James (Williams) - guitar
about: Second studio album by the Seattle soul jazz organ trio led by Delvon Lamarr, released through Colemine Records. It entered several Billboard charts and drew on funk and blues alongside the band's organ-driven grooves.

title: Requiem
label: Sub Pop Records
about: Self-produced third album from the masked Swedish collective Goat, issued by Rocket Recordings. The lengthy thirteen-track record received generally favourable reviews from critics.

title: Rejuvination
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Ziggy Modeliste – drums, composer, producer, vocals Art Neville – keyboards, composer, producer, vocals Leo Nocentelli – guitar, composer, producer, background vocals George Porter, Jr. – bass, composer, producer, background vocals

tracks.t: Loving You Is On My Mind

about: New Orleans funk band the Meters made this Reprise album with producer Allen Toussaint at Sea-Saint Studios. Mixing funk with swamp rock, it is widely regarded as a peak of the genre and appeared on a major magazine's greatest-albums list.

title: Who Is William Onyeabor?
label: Luaka Bop

tracks.t: The Way To Win Your Love
When The Going Is Smooth And Good

about: Luaka Bop collection of songs by Nigerian synth-funk musician William Onyeabor, assembled by Uchenna Ikonne. It was the first authorised reissue of his music, previously available mostly as bootlegs or rare originals, and received wide critical praise.

title: Soft And Beautiful
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: I Wish I Didn't Love You So
(Ah, The Apple Trees) When The World Was Young

about: Aretha Franklin recorded this Clyde Otis-produced set in 1964, but Columbia held it back until 1969, after she had moved to Atlantic. It was her final album for Columbia and reached the R&B chart top thirty.

title: Sweet Little Jesus Boy
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: Go Tell It On The Mountain

about: A 1955 long-playing record of Christmas material by gospel singer Mahalia Jackson, issued with catalogue number CL 702 shortly after she joined Columbia. It is among the earliest LPs listed in her discography.

title: Stadium Arcadium
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Anthony Kiedis – lead vocals John Frusciante – guitars, backing vocals, keyboards, synthesizer, mellotron Flea – bass guitar, trumpet Chad Smith – drums, percussion
about: The ninth studio album by Red Hot Chili Peppers, a double album produced by Rick Rubin and first released in May 2006. Combining funk and alternative rock, it became the band's first record to top the US chart.

title: How To Dismantle An Atomic Bomb
label: Island Records
personnel: Bono – vocals, guitar, piano The Edge – guitar, vocals, piano, keyboards, percussion, synthesiser Adam Clayton – bass Larry Mullen Jr. – drums, percussion, vocals

tracks.t: Sometimes You Can't Make It On Your Own

about: U2's eleventh studio album, released in November 2004. It continued the guitar-driven rock approach of its predecessor and includes the single Vertigo, and it went on to win several Grammy Awards including Album of the Year.

title: No Line On The Horizon
label: Island Records
personnel: Bono – lead vocals, guitar The Edge – guitar, backing vocals, piano Adam Clayton – bass guitar Larry Mullen Jr. – drums, percussion

tracks.t: I'll Go Crazy If I Don't Go Crazy Tonight
I'll Go Crazy If I Don't Go Crazy Tonight (Redanka's 'Kick Darkness' Vocal Version)

about: U2's twelfth studio album, issued in February 2009 and made with producers Brian Eno, Daniel Lanois and Steve Lillywhite. It topped charts in many countries, though its sales fell short of the band's earlier releases.

title: Sound Ancestors
label: Madlib Invazion
about: A sample-based hip hop instrumental album produced by Madlib and released in January 2021 on Madlib Invazion. British producer Four Tet arranged, edited and mastered the material, shaping Madlib's beats into a cohesive record.

title: Show Some Emotion
label: A&M Records
personnel: Joan Armatrading – vocals, guitar; thumb piano (mbira) Jerry Donahue – guitar Bryan Garofalo, Dave Markee – bass Georgie Fame – Fender Rhodes electric piano John "Rabbit" Bundrick – Hammond organ
about: Joan Armatrading's fourth studio album, produced by Glyn Johns and issued by A&M in September 1977. It reached number six on the UK albums chart.

title: Sunlit Youth
label: Loma Vista
personnel: Taylor Rice Kelcey Ayer Ryan Hahn Matt Frazier Nik Ewing
about: The third studio album by Los Angeles indie rock band Local Natives, released in September 2016 on Loma Vista in the US. It was recorded in several countries between 2014 and 2016.

title: Solace
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Tyrone Lindqvist Jon George James Hunt
about: The third studio album by Australian electronic trio Rüfüs Du Sol, released in October 2018 through Rose Avenue and Sony Music Australia. It was the first record they issued under the Rüfüs Du Sol name worldwide.

title: Goodbye Jumbo
label: Seaview Records
personnel: Karl Wallinger – vocals, all instruments (except as indicated), composition Guy Chambers – synthesizer Chris Sharrock - drum kit Jeff Trott – guitar

tracks.t: Put The Message In The Box
Ain't Gonna Come Till I'm Ready

about: World Party's second studio album, put out by Ensign Records in 1990, with the US release in April and the UK release in May. Largely the work of Karl Wallinger, it produced the UK singles Way Down Now and Put the Message in the Box.

title: Reckoning
label: I.R.S. Records
personnel: Michael Stipe – lead vocals and harmonica Bill Berry – drums, percussion, and backing vocals Peter Buck – guitar Mike Mills – bass guitar, piano and backing vocals
about: R.E.M.'s second studio album, issued by I.R.S. Records in April 1984 and produced by Mitch Easter and Don Dixon. Recorded in Charlotte, North Carolina, it followed Murmur with a rawer, more live-sounding jangle pop approach.

title: All That You Can't Leave Behind
label: Island Records
personnel: Bono – vocals, guitar, synthesisers The Edge – guitar, piano, vocals, synthesisers, strings Adam Clayton – bass guitar Larry Mullen Jr. – drums, percussion

tracks.t: Stuck In A Moment You Can't Get Out Of
When I Look At The World

about: U2's tenth studio album, released in October 2000 and produced by Brian Eno and Daniel Lanois. After the experimental 1990s, it marked a return to a leaner, more traditional rock sound and featured the hit Beautiful Day.

title: Trouble Will Find Me
label: 4AD
personnel: Matt Berninger – lead vocals Aaron Dessner – guitar, keyboards, vibraphone, harmonica Bryce Dessner – guitar, keyboards, e-bow, orchestration Scott Devendorf – bass guitar Bryan Devendorf – drums, percussion
about: The National's sixth studio album, released on 4AD in May 2013 and co-produced by band members Aaron and Bryce Dessner. Critics received it warmly, and it reached number three on the Billboard 200.

title: Remind Me Tomorrow
label: Jagjaguwar
personnel: Sharon Van Etten – vocals, piano, organ Heather Woods Broderick – vocals, synthesizer, electric piano Zachary Dawes – bass
McKenzie Smith – drums Luke Reynolds – lap steel guitar, guitar synthesizer John Congleton – synthesizer, drone, percussion Jamie Stewart – synthesizer, vocals, guitar
about: Sharon Van Etten's fifth studio album, produced by John Congleton and released on Jagjaguwar in January 2019. Her first full-length in about five years, it moved toward a synth-heavy sound and drew wide critical praise.

title: Solace Remixed
label: Rose Avenue
personnel: Tyrone Lindqvist Jon George James Hunt
about: The first remix collection by Rüfüs Du Sol, released digitally in September 2019, with physical formats following in Australia that October. It gathers reworked versions of songs from their 2018 album Solace by various producers.

title: America Eats Its Young
label: Westbound Records

tracks.t: You Hit The Nail On The Head
If You Don't Like The Effects, Don't Produce The Cause
Everybody Is Going To Make It This Time

about: Funkadelic's fourth studio album and its first double album, released on Westbound in May 1972. Following Maggot Brain, it blends funk, rock and jazz-rock and features a larger cast of musicians from the Parliament-Funkadelic circle.

title: Push The Sky Away
label: Bad Seed Ltd.
personnel: Nick Cave – vocals, piano, electric piano, additional mixing, design Warren Ellis – violin, viola, tenor guitar, flute, synthesizer, electric piano Martyn P
Conway Savage – vocals, vocals Thomas Wydler – drums, vocals
about: The fifteenth studio album by Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds, recorded in the south of France with producer Nick Launay and released in February 2013. Critics praised it, and it became the band's first album to reach number one in Australia.

title: Sound Of Silver
label: DFA Records
personnel: James Murphy – vocals, drums, percussion, bass , piano, guitar, organ Patrick Mahoney – drums, percussion Tyler Pope – guitars, bass Nancy Whang – vocals

tracks.t: New York, I Love You But You're Bringing Me Down

about: A dance-punk record by LCD Soundsystem, recorded in 2006 and released in March 2007 through DFA, with EMI and Capitol handling distribution. It was widely acclaimed and earned a Grammy nomination.

title: Half The City
label: Single Lock Records
about: The first full-length record from the Birmingham, Alabama soul band, issued through Single Lock Records in February 2014. It introduced the group's horn-driven Southern soul sound fronted by singer Paul Janeway.

title: Chocolate City
label: Mercury Records
personnel: George Clinton – vocals Bootsy Collins – bass, guitar, drums
Raymond Davis – vocals Ramon "Tiki" Fulwood – drums. Clarence "Fuzzy" Haskins – vocals
Prakash John, Cordell Mosson – bass Tyrone Lampkin, Man In The Box – Drums. Billy "Bass" Nelson – bass

tracks.t: If It Don't Fit (Don't Force It)

about: Parliament's third studio LP, put out by Casablanca in April 1975 and produced by George Clinton. The funk record pays homage to Washington, D.C., and its title song served as the lead single.

title: The Black Saint And The Sinner Lady
label: Superior Viaduct
personnel: Charles Mingus – double bass, piano, composer Jerome Richardson, Dick Hafer – saxophone, flute Charlie Mariano – saxophone
Rolf Ericson, Richard Williams – trumpet Quentin Jackson – trombone
Don Butterfield – tuba, trombone Jaki Byard – piano

tracks.t: Solo Dancer (Stop! And Listen, Sinner Jim Whitney!)
Duet Solo Dancers (Heart's Beat And Shades In Physical Embraces)
Group Dancers ([Soul Fusion] Freewoman And Oh This Freedom's Slave Cries)
Trio And Group Dancers (Stop! Look! And Sing Songs Of Revolutions!)
Single Solos And Group Dance (Saint And Sinner Join In Merriment On Battle Front)
Group And Solo Dance (Of Love, Pain, And Passioned Revolt, Then Farewell, My Beloved, 'til It's Freedom Day)

about: A Charles Mingus album recorded in a single day in January 1963 and issued by Impulse! that July, with Bob Thiele producing. Conceived as one extended, partly ballet-inspired composition split across several tracks, it is frequently counted among the finest jazz recordings.

title: Abeti
label: Production IRIS

tracks.t: Mwasi Ya Boungo I Love You

about: A self-titled 1975 record by Congolese singer Abeti Masikini, her second album after her 1973 debut. It came out during the period when she was building an international following for her soukous and rumba music.

title: Happiness
label: G Clef
personnel: Errol Francis 'Froggy', Jacob Thomas 'Bobby' 'Top Cat' - vocals Teddy Walters, Lloyd Willacy 'Cookie' - guitar, vocals Garth Bright 'Maestro' - bass, vocals, band leader Patrick Smith 'JJ' - drums, vocals Dorrel Salmon 'Fish' 'Proff' - organ, electric piano, clavinet

title: Reality
label: Pseudonym Records
personnel: Tony Shearman - vocals Leslie Vos - vocals Jules McDonald - bass Roel Burnet - congas
William Lindfors Jr. - drums Glenn Gaddum - organ
Franky Douglas - guitar Rudy Van Wilgen - timbales

title: World Music
label: Rocket Recordings
about: The first studio album by the Swedish psychedelic rock collective Goat, released in August 2012 by Rocket Recordings and Stranded Rekords. It drew strong critical praise and reached the top ten of the Swedish albums chart.

title: Get Your Hands Off Of My Man
label: TRIBAL United Kingdom

tracks.t: Get Your Hands Off My Man (Sound Factory Mix)
Get Your Hands Off My Man (Bass Dub)
Get Your Hands Off My Man (Dubstramental)
Get Your Hands Off My Man (The Big Dub)

about: A 1994 dance single by New York club DJ and producer Junior Vasquez, known for his residency at the Sound Factory. The track was issued on 12-inch vinyl and charted in the United Kingdom.

title: Symphony In D Minor, Op. 13
label: Artia Recording Corporation
personnel: Antonin Dvorak - composer Vaclav Neumann - conductor The Prague Symphony Orchestra - orchestra
about: A classical LP of Antonín Dvořák's Symphony No. 4 in D minor, Op. 13, an early symphony the Czech composer wrote in the 1870s. The specific performers and the original issue date of this pressing could not be confirmed.

title: Symphony No. 4 In G Major, Op. 88
label: Artia Recording Corporation
personnel: Antonin Dvorak - composer Vaclav Talich - conductor The Czech Philharmonic Orchestra - orchestra
about: A recording of the Dvořák symphony in G major now known as No. 8, printed here under the older numbering as No. 4. The four-movement work dates from 1889 and draws on Bohemian folk-like melodies. The specific performers and issue of this LP could not be confirmed.

title: Symphony No. 3 In F Major, Op. 76
label: Artia Recording Corporation
personnel: Antonin Dvorak - composer Karel Sejna, Vaclav Talich - conductor The Czech Philharmonic Orchestra - orchestra

tracks.t: The Midday Witch, Symphonic Poem, Op. 108

about: A recording of the Dvořák symphony in F major, Op. 76, which modern catalogues number as No. 5; older editions called it No. 3. Composed in 1875 and revised before publication, it is a pastoral, lyrical work. The specific performers and issue of this LP could not be confirmed.

title: Gangsta’s Paradise
label: Tommy Boy
about: Coolio's second studio album, released by Tommy Boy in November 1995. Blending West Coast hip-hop and G-funk, it became his biggest seller, and its Grammy-winning title song topped the Billboard Hot 100.

title: Dreamland
label: Wolf Tone
personnel: Dave Bayley – vocals, keyboards, guitar, drums, percussion, strings Andrew MacFarlane – strings, guitar, keyboards Edmund Irwin Singer – guitar, keyboards, vocals, strings, synthesizer Joe Seaward – drums, percussion
about: The third studio album by English band Glass Animals, issued in August 2020 on Wolf Tone and Polydor. Produced mostly by frontman Dave Bayley, it draws on his childhood memories and peaked at number two in the UK.

title: Nevermind
label: Geffen Records
personnel: Kurt Cobain – vocals, guitars Krist Novoselic – bass, vocals Dave Grohl – drums, vocals
about: Nirvana's second studio album, released by DGC Records in September 1991. Its breakthrough success brought grunge and alternative rock into the mainstream.

title: The Incredible Year - 1968
label: CBS

tracks.t: Tet, Politics, The Martin Luther King Assassination
Dissent, The Primaries, The Robert F. Kennedy Assassination
The Conventions; The Campaign, Protest, And War

about: A spoken-word LP issued by CBS in which newsman Charles Kuralt narrates a review of the events of 1968. Produced by CBS News, it covers the King and Robert Kennedy assassinations, the presidential primaries and conventions, the Vietnam War and protests, and unrest abroad.

title: Days Gone By
label: Domino
about: The first studio album by Canadian electronic duo Bob Moses, released on Domino in September 2015. It received generally favourable reviews and was later expanded with bonus material in a deluxe edition.

title: Sailor
label: Capitol Records
personnel: Steve Miller – guitar, lead vocals, harmonica Boz Scaggs – guitar, vocals Lonnie Turner – bass, vocals Jim Peterman – keyboards, vocals Tim Davis – drums, vocals
about: The Steve Miller Band's second studio album, released by Capitol in October 1968 and co-produced with Glyn Johns. It reached number 24 in the US and was the final record with Boz Scaggs and Jim Peterman.

title: At The Grass Roots Of Dub
label: Studio 16
personnel: King Tubby (Osbourne Ruddock) (side A) The Upsetter (Lee "Scratch" Perry) (side B) The Natty Dread, Winston Edwards - vocals

tracks.t: King And The Upsetter At Spanish Town

about: An instrumental dub album produced by Winston Edwards and first issued in 1974 on Total Sounds in Jamaica and Fay Music in the UK. King Tubby mixed one side and Lee Perry the other, with much of it recorded at Perry's Black Ark studio.

title: An Ode To Escapism
label: Karma Chief Records
personnel: Seth Applebaum Lo Gwynn, Romi Hanoch, Megan Mancini - vocals
about: A 2020 album by the Brooklyn-based Ghost Funk Orchestra, released on Colemine's Karma Chief imprint. It followed the group's 2019 full-length A Song for Paul and continued its mix of psychedelic soul, funk and Latin influences.

title: Wanted Dread & Alive
label: EMI America
personnel: Peter Tosh - vocals, guitar, keyboards, percussion The Tamlins - vocals
Keith Sterling, Robbie Lyn - keyboards Noel "Scully" Simms, Uziah Thompson - percussion Dean Fraser - saxophone. Ronald "Nambo" Robinson - trombone
about: Peter Tosh's fifth studio album, recorded at Dynamic Studios in Kingston and issued in June 1981 on Rolling Stones Records and EMI America. It includes a duet with Gwen Guthrie and made a modest showing on the Billboard 200.

title: Kid A Mnesia
label: XL Recordings
personnel: Colin Greenwood. Jonny Greenwood. Ed O'Brien. Philip Selway. Thom Yorke

tracks.t: Packt Like Sardines In A Crushd Tin Box
The Morning Bell (In The Dark Version)

about: A 2021 Radiohead reissue on XL Recordings that pairs Kid A and Amnesiac with a third disc of previously unreleased material from the same sessions. It was very well received by critics.

title: Bryter Layter
label: Island Records

tracks.t: At The Chime Of A City Clock

about: Nick Drake's second studio album, released by Island in March 1971 and produced by Joe Boyd. It features guest players including members of Fairport Convention and John Cale, and was his final record with full accompaniment.

title: The Swing
label: ATCO Records
personnel: Michael Hutchence – vocals Garry Gary Beers – bass, vocals Andrew Farriss – keyboards, guitar
Tim Farriss – guitar Jon Farriss – drums, percussion, vocals Kirk Pengilly – guitar, saxophone, vocals
about: INXS's fourth studio album, produced by Nick Launay and Nile Rodgers and released in March 1984. It spent five weeks at number one in Australia and included the single Original Sin.

title: So
label: Geffen Records
personnel: Peter Gabriel – vocals, CMI, synthesizer, piano, LinnSequencer
Stewart Copeland – hi-hat, drums Daniel Lanois – guitar, tambourine, surf guitar, twelve-string guitar
about: Peter Gabriel's fifth studio album, released in May 1986. Combining art rock with soul and African and Brazilian influences, it became his best-selling solo work, and its single Sledgehammer reached number one in the US.

title: Transatlanticism
label: Barsuk Records
personnel: Benjamin Gibbard – vocals, guitar, piano Nick Harmer – bass Jason McGerr – drums, percussion Christopher Walla – guitar, keyboards
about: The fourth studio album by indie rock band Death Cab for Cutie, released on Barsuk in October 2003. It was their last independent-label record before they moved to a major label.

title: Legend
label: Island Records
about: A posthumous greatest-hits collection of Bob Marley and the Wailers, issued by Island in 1984. It became one of the best-selling reggae records ever and has remained on charts for decades.

title: Midnight Love
label: Columbia
personnel: Marvin Gaye – vocals, Fender Rhodes piano, synthesizer, organ, drums, drum machine, drum programming, bells, glockenspiel, vibraphone, finger cymbals, bongos, congas, and cabasas Gordon Banks – guitar, bass, vocals, drums
Bobby Stern – sax, harmonica Joel Peskin – alto & tenor sax
about: Marvin Gaye's first album for Columbia after leaving Motown, made largely in Belgium with heavy use of synthesizers and drum machines. It contains the hit Sexual Healing, which earned him Grammy awards, and it was the last album he released before his death in 1984.

title: Greatest Hits
label: United Artists Records
personnel: Papa Dee Allen, Harold Brown, B.B. Dickerson, Lonnie Jordan, Charles Miller, Lee Oskar, Howard Scott
about: A 1976 hits collection by the Los Angeles funk band War, gathering their best-known singles. It also introduced the new song Summer, which became a hit.

title: Solid Ground
label: Record Kicks
personnel: Daryl "The Gata" Norcott - lead vocals Kevin O'Dea - guitar, tambourine, cabasa, hand claps, vocals Aaron Julin - organ, piano, synthesizer, trombone, tambourine, guiro, vocals Goopy Rossi - bass

tracks.t: Bold Soul Sister, Bold Soul Brother

about: The first full-length record by the Grease Traps, a deep funk and soul group from Oakland, California, released by Record Kicks. Its eleven tracks were cut at studios in San Francisco and Oakland, and the singles Bird of Paradise and More and More preceded it on 45.

title: Eliminator
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Billy Gibbons – guitar, vocals Dusty Hill – bass, vocals Frank Beard – drums

tracks.t: If I Could Only Flag Her Down

about: The eighth studio record by Texas trio ZZ Top, issued by Warner Bros. in March 1983. It became the group's biggest seller, with around 11 million copies sold and diamond status in the United States.

title: Legalize It
label: Columbia
personnel: Peter Tosh – guitar, keyboards, vocals Al Anderson, Donald Kinsey – guitar Aston Barrett, Robbie Shakespeare – bass Carlton "Santa" Davis, Carlton Barrett – drums Tyrone "Organ D" Downie – keyboards. Robbie "Ras" Lee – harmonica Rita Marley, Judy Mowatt, Bunny Wailer – background vocals
about: Peter Tosh's first solo studio record, self-produced in Kingston and put out by Virgin and Columbia in 1976. The reggae set campaigns for cannabis legalisation, and the banning of its title song in Jamaica ended up boosting his international profile. It was later certified platinum in the US.

title: Star Wars: The Story Of Return Of The Jedi
label: Buena Vista Records

tracks.t: The Story Of Return Of The Jedi (Part 1)
The Story Of Return Of The Jedi (Part 2)

about: An abridged audio retelling of Return of the Jedi produced by Walt Disney's Buena Vista Records. Narrated by Chuck Riley, it combines dialogue, sound effects and John Williams' score from the 1983 film to tell the story for home listeners.

title: Soultrane
label: Original Jazz Classics
personnel: John Coltrane – tenor saxophone Red Garland – piano Paul Chambers – bass Art Taylor – drums

tracks.t: I Want To Talk About You

about: A Prestige album led by saxophonist John Coltrane, recorded in a single session on February 7, 1958. Backed by Red Garland, Paul Chambers and Art Taylor, he plays standards and ballads in the rapid, densely packed style later dubbed sheets of sound.

title: Del Jones' Positive Vibes
label: Hikeka Records
personnel: Benny R. Mitchell – bass, directed by

tracks.t: Times Are Hard Friends Are Few

about: A funk and jazz record by Philadelphia bandleader Del Jones and his group Positive Vibes, privately pressed in about 2,500 copies on his own Hikeka label. It revisits material from his rawer Court Is Closed with more polished arrangements and was later reissued by Now-Again Records.

title: The Keyboard King At Studio One
label: Soul Jazz Records
about: A 2000 anthology gathering recordings Jamaican keyboardist Jackie Mittoo made at Studio One. It was issued on CD and vinyl through Soul Jazz Records and its Universal Sound imprint.

title: Electric Ladyland
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Jimi Hendrix – vocals, guitars, piano, percussion, electric harpsichord, bass Noel Redding – backing vocals, bass, acoustic guitar Mitch Mitchell – backing vocals, drums, percussion

tracks.t: Have You Ever Been (To Electric Ladyland)
1983... (A Merman I Should Turn To Be)
Moon, Turn The Tides... Gently Gently Away

about: The third and last studio set by the Jimi Hendrix Experience, a double album that Reprise released in the US in October 1968, with Track's UK edition following shortly after.

title: Dirty Honey
label: Dirt Records
personnel: Marc Labelle - vocals John Notto - guitar Corey Coverstone - drums Justin Smolian - bass
about: The first full-length studio album by Los Angeles hard rock band Dirty Honey, released in April 2021. It followed the group's self-titled 2019 EP.

title: Cosmic Slop
label: Westbound Records
personnel: Bernard Worrell - keyboards, melodica "Boogie" Mosson - bass Eddie Hazel, Garry Shider, Ron Bykowski - lead & rhythm guitar Tyrone Lampkin - percussion

tracks.t: You Can't Miss What You Can't Measure

about: Funkadelic's fifth studio album, released on Westbound Records in mid-1973.

title: Dread At The Control Dubwise
label: Dread At The Controls
about: A dub companion to Mikey Dread's 1979 set Dread at the Controls, named after the radio show that made the Jamaican broadcaster and producer famous. It presents stripped-down, effects-laden instrumental versions of his productions.

title: The Cars
label: Elektra
personnel: Ric Ocasek – vocals, rhythm guitar Benjamin Orr – vocals, bass David Robinson – drums, percussion, Syndrums, backing vocals Elliot Easton – lead guitar, backing vocals Greg Hawkes – keyboards, percussion, saxophone, backing vocals

tracks.t: I'm In Touch With Your World

about: The self-titled first album by Boston band the Cars, put out by Elektra in June 1978.

title: American Dream
label: DFA
personnel: James Murphy – vocals, drums, bass, guitar, synthesizers, piano Al Doyle – piano, synthesizers, guitar, vocals Nancy Whang, Tyler Pope Matt Thornley, Korey Richey
about: LCD Soundsystem's comeback studio album, issued by DFA and Columbia in September 2017 after the band reunited. Wikipedia counts it as the group's fifth studio release.

title: Skeleton Tree
label: Bad Seed Ltd.
personnel: Nick Cave – vocals, piano, Wurlitzer, synthesizer, vibraphone, backing vocals Warren Ellis – synthesizer, loops, Wurlitzer, piano, baritone tenor guitar, violin, viola, drum treatments, drum loops, backing vocals Martyn Casey – bass Thomas Wydler – drums Jim Sclavunos – percussion, vibraphone, tubular bells, backing vocals George Vjestica – acoustic guitar, backing vocals
about: The sixteenth studio album from Australian group Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds, released in September 2016 through the band's own Bad Seed Ltd. via Kobalt.

label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Prince – Lead vocals, backing vocals, electric guitar, bass guitar, keyboard, piano, synthesiser, drums, percussion Dez Dickerson – vocals, electric guitar, backing vocals Lisa Coleman, Jill Jones – backing vocals

tracks.t: Something In The Water (Does Not Compute)
All The Critics Love U In New York

about: Prince's fifth studio album and the first to credit his backing group the Revolution. He produced it himself, recording in Minnesota and Hollywood, and Warner Bros. issued it in October 1982.

title: Debut
label: One Little Indian
personnel: Björk – lead vocals, arranger, programmer, basslines, keyboards, brass. Garry Hughes, Marius de Vries, Martin Virgo, Paul Waller – keyboards
Talvin Singh – tabla Jon Mallison – guitar

tracks.t: There's More To Life Than This (Recorded Live At The Milk Bar Toilets)

about: Björk's first international solo studio album, co-produced with Nellee Hooper and released in July 1993 on One Little Indian, with Elektra handling the US.

title: Lost In Translation (Music From The Motion Picture Soundtrack)
label: Emperor Norton

tracks.t: Brian Reitzell & Roger Joseph Manning-The Shibuya
Brian Reitzell & Roger Joseph Manning Jr.– On Subway
The Jesus And Mary Chain– Just Like Honey

about: Companion album to Sofia Coppola's 2003 film, overseen by Brian Reitzell and released on Emperor Norton. It leans on dream pop and shoegaze, featuring Kevin Shields, Air, Phoenix and the Jesus and Mary Chain, and was well received by critics.

title: Making Movies
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Mark Knopfler – vocals, guitar John Illsley – bass guitar, vocals Pick Withers – drums, vocals
about: Dire Straits' third studio album, the follow-up to Communiqué, released in October 1980 by Vertigo, with Warner Bros. distributing it in the US.

title: Commune
label: Rocket Recordings
about: The second studio album by Swedish experimental collective Goat, released in September 2014 via Rocket Recordings, with Sub Pop handling North America.

title: Confuse The Marketplace
label: DFA
about: A DFA Records EP pressed as a 12-inch that gathered, for North American buyers, B-sides from LCD Soundsystem's European Sound of Silver singles. It opens with the long track Freak Out/Starry Eyes.

title: Warpaint
label: Rough Trade
personnel: Emily Kokal - Guitar, Vocals Jenny Lee Lindberg - Bass, Vocals Stella Mozgawa - Drums Theresa Wayman - Guitar, Keyboards, Vocals
about: The self-titled second studio album by Los Angeles indie rock group Warpaint, co-produced by the band with Flood and released on Rough Trade in January 2014.

title: Slade Alive!
label: Polydor
personnel: Noddy Holder - lead vocals, rhythm guitar Dave Hill - lead guitar, backing vocals Jim Lea - bass, backing vocals Don Powell - drums

tracks.t: In Like A Shot From My Gun
Get Down And Get With It

about: Slade's first live record, cut over three nights in October 1971 at Command Studios in London with Chas Chandler producing. Polydor released it in 1972; it reached number two in Britain and topped the Australian chart.

title: Low
label: Parlophone
personnel: David Bowie – vocals, saxophones, guitar, bass, harmonica, keyboards

tracks.t: Always Crashing In The Same Car
A New Career In A New Town

about: The first entry in David Bowie's Berlin Trilogy, made with Brian Eno and producer Tony Visconti. Its first side holds short, fragmentary songs while the second consists mainly of ambient instrumentals, and its sound proved hugely influential on later post-punk and electronic music.

title: Fair Warning
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: David Lee Roth – lead vocals Eddie Van Halen – guitar, synthesizers, backing vocals Michael Anthony – bass guitar, backing vocals Alex Van Halen – drums
about: The fourth Van Halen record, generally regarded as the band's darkest and heaviest album of the David Lee Roth era. It sold more slowly than its predecessors at first but eventually went double platinum and is admired for Eddie Van Halen's guitar work.

title: Capitol Cuts
label: ATO Records
personnel: Eric Burton – vocals, guitar Adrian Quesada – guitar
about: A live set by Austin soul band Black Pumas recorded in Studio A at Capitol Studios in Los Angeles, captured direct to acetate without overdubs. Issued by ATO Records, it features eight performances including an extended version of Colors.

title: Just Another Way To Say I Love You
label: Warner Bros Records

tracks.t: Heavenly, That's What You Are To Me
I'll Do For You Anything You Want Me To
What Am I Gonna Do With You
Let Me Live My Life Lovin' You Babe

about: Barry White's fourth studio album, issued on 20th Century Records and produced by White himself. It continued his run of lush orchestral soul and included the hit What Am I Gonna Do with You.

title: Invisible Touch
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Tony Banks – keyboards, synth bass Phil Collins – drums, percussion, vocals Mike Rutherford – guitars, bass

tracks.t: Part One - In The Glow Of The Night

about: The thirteenth Genesis studio album and the best-selling record of their career. Featuring Phil Collins, Tony Banks and Mike Rutherford, it yielded five US top-five singles, among them the title song, which reached number one in America.

title: Blue 4 U
label: Astro Lizard Records
personnel: Tony Alva Matthew Rainwater Vulcho Bonev Rachel Anne Rainwater
about: A nine-track release by His Eyes Have Fangs, a Los Angeles project involving skateboarder Tony Alva with Matthew and Rachel Anne Rainwater. Issued on Astro Lizard Records, it blends dream rock, surf and psychedelic textures and appeared on CD and limited white vinyl.

title: Hunky Dory
label: Parlophone
personnel: David Bowie – vocals, guitar, alto and tenor saxophone, piano Mick Ronson – guitar, vocals, Mellotron, arrangements Trevor Bolder – bass guitar, trumpet Mick Woodmansey – drums Rick Wakeman – piano
about: David Bowie's fourth studio album, a piano-led set featuring Changes, Oh! You Pretty Things and Life on Mars?. It sold modestly on release but gained success after Ziggy Stardust and is now viewed as one of his finest works.

title: Waylon & Willie
label: RCA Victor

tracks.t: Mammas Don't Let Your Babies Grow Up To Be Cowboys
If You Can Touch Her At All
It's Not Supposed To Be That Way
I Can Get Off On You
The Wurlitzer Prize (I Don't Want To Get Over You)

about: The first collaborative studio album by country singers Waylon Jennings and Willie Nelson, released by RCA. It includes the hit Mammas Don't Let Your Babies Grow Up to Be Cowboys, which topped the country chart and won a Grammy.

title: Layla And Other Assorted Love Songs
label: RSO
personnel: Eric Clapton – vocals, guitars Bobby Whitlock – vocals, keyboards; acoustic guitar Carl Radle – bass, percussion Jim Gordon – drums, percussion; piano Duane Allman – guitars

tracks.t: Nobody Knows You When You're Down And Out
Why Does Love Got To Be So Sad?
Have You Ever Loved A Woman

about: The sole studio record by Eric Clapton's band Derek and the Dominos, issued as a double LP and produced by Tom Dowd with the group. Duane Allman added lead and slide guitar to most tracks. Sales were weak at first, but it later went gold and entered the Grammy Hall of Fame.

title: Out Of The Blue
label: Jet Records
personnel: Jeff Lynne – vocals, guitars, Wurlitzer electric piano, Minimoog Bev Bevan – drums, Rototoms, cymbals, backing vocals Richard Tandy – piano, Minimoog, clavinet, guitar Kelly Groucutt – vocals, bass, percussion Mik Kaminski – violin
about: A double album written by Jeff Lynne in a few weeks at a Swiss chalet and then recorded in Munich. It climbed to number four in both Britain and America and stands as the most commercially successful studio release by Electric Light Orchestra.

title: Beggars Banquet
label: London Records
personnel: Mick Jagger – vocals, harmonica, maracas Keith Richards – guitar, bass, vocals Brian Jones – guitar, harmonica, Mellotron, sitar, tambura, vocals Bill Wyman – bass, vocals, shekere, maracas Charlie Watts – drums, claves, tambourine, tabla, vocals
about: The first Rolling Stones LP produced by Jimmy Miller, it moved the band away from psychedelic pop toward blues and roots-based rock. Critics hailed it as a comeback, and it reached the top five in both the UK and the US.

title: Wild And Peaceful
label: De-Lite Records
personnel: Robert "Kool" Bell – bass, vocals "Funky" George Brown – drums, percussion, vocals Ricky West – electric piano, vocals
Clay Smith – guitar Dennis "Dee Tee" Thomas – alto saxophone, flute, congas, vocals Ronald Bell – tenor and soprano saxophones, vocals Robert "Spike" Mickens – trumpet, vocals

tracks.t: This Is You, This Is Me
Life Is What You Make It

about: Self-produced by Kool & the Gang for De-Lite, this record became the group's commercial breakthrough and was certified gold. It yielded their first three top-ten singles, among them Jungle Boogie, and reached the top ten of the R&B album chart.

title: Document
label: I.R.S. Records
personnel: Michael Stipe – lead vocals Bill Berry – drums, backing vocals Peter Buck – guitar, dulcimer on "King of Birds" Mike Mills – bass guitar, keyboards, backing vocals

tracks.t: It's The End Of The World As We Know It (And I Feel Fine)

about: R.E.M.'s first collaboration with co-producer Scott Litt, released on I.R.S. Records. It became their first top-ten album in the US and their first platinum record, helped by the hit single The One I Love.

title: Illadelph Halflife (Clean LP)
label: DGC
personnel: The Grand Negaz, Questlove, Black Thought, Kelo, Q-Tip (The Ummah), Raphael Saadiq, Scratch, Chaos, L.A. Jay, Slimkid3, Scott Storch
about: Released on DGC/Geffen, the Roots' third album has a harder and wider-ranging sound than its predecessor and includes guest turns from artists such as D'Angelo and Cassandra Wilson. The Source later placed it among its 100 best rap albums.

title: Seventeen Seconds
label: Music On Vinyl
personnel: Robert Smith – guitars, vocals Matthieu Hartley – keyboards Lol Tolhurst – drums Simon Gallup – bass
about: The Cure recorded and mixed this sparse record in about a week on a very small budget, with Mike Hedges and Robert Smith producing. It reached number 20 in the UK and is frequently cited as an early gothic rock landmark.

title: Achtung Baby
label: Island Records
personnel: Bono – lead vocals, guitar The Edge – guitar, keyboards, vocals Adam Clayton – bass guitar Larry Mullen Jr. – drums, percussion

tracks.t: Even Better Than The Real Thing
Until The End Of The World
Who's Gonna Ride Your Wild Horses
Tryin' To Throw Your Arms Around The World

about: Produced by Daniel Lanois and Brian Eno, this release saw U2 reinvent their sound with industrial, electronic and alternative influences. It debuted at the top of the Billboard 200, sold roughly 18 million copies and earned a Grammy.
vinylColor: Red Translucent, 180 Gram / Blue Translucent. 180 Gram

title: Physical Graffiti
label: Swan Song
personnel: Robert Plant – vocals, harmonica Jimmy Page – electric, acoustic, lap steel and slide guitars, production John Paul Jones – bass guitar, mandolin, acoustic guitar, keyboards John Bonham – drums, percussion
about: Led Zeppelin's first release on their Swan Song label, this double album combined new songs cut at Headley Grange in 1974 with unused earlier recordings. Its intricate die-cut sleeve delayed release, and it went on to top the UK chart and sell over eight million US copies.

title: Roosevelt
label: City Slang
personnel: Roosevelt (Marius Lauber) Valeska Steiner – Backing Vocals
about: The first full-length album by Roosevelt, the stage name of German producer and singer Marius Lauber. It presents his synth-pop and indie electronic style and was released in August 2016.

title: Cyrano (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)
label: Decca
personnel: Music by Bryce Dessner & Aaron Dessner Lyrics by Matt Berninger & Carin Besser
Vikingur Olafsson - piano Peter Dinklage, Hayley Bennett, Beverly Rudd, Kelvin Harrison Jr. - vocals The National
about: Music for Joe Wright's 2021 film Cyrano starring Peter Dinklage, composed and produced by Aaron and Bryce Dessner, with song lyrics by Matt Berninger and Carin Besser. The cast sings the songs, and the London Contemporary Orchestra plays the score. Decca issued it.

title: In Outer Space
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Russell Mael – vocals Ron Mael – keyboards Bob Haag – guitars
James Goodwin – keyboards Jane Wiedlin – guest vocals

tracks.t: All You Ever Think About Is Sex
I Wish I Looked A Little Better
A Fun Bunch Of Guys From Outer Space

about: Self-produced by Ron and Russell Mael for Atlantic, this Sparks record reached number 88 in the US. It includes Cool Places, a duet with Jane Wiedlin that became the duo's biggest American hit, though reviews were mixed.

title: What Went Down
label: Transgressive Records
personnel: Yannis Philippakis – vocals, guitar, art direction Jack Bevan – drums Jimmy Smith – guitar, keyboards Walter Gervers – bass, backing vocals Edwin Congreave – keyboards, backing vocals
about: Produced by James Ford, the fourth Foals album entered the UK chart at number three and gave the band their best US placing at the time. Critics received it favourably.

title: Propaganda
label: Island Records
personnel: Russell Mael - vocals Ron Mael - keyboards Trevor White, Adrian Fisher - guitar Ian Hampton - bass Norman "Dinky" Diamond - drums

tracks.t: At Home, At Work, At Play
Don't Leave Me Alone With Her
Never Turn Your Back On Mother Earth
Something For The Girl With Everything

about: Sparks followed their breakthrough Kimono My House with this Island release produced by Muff Winwood. It made the UK top ten, and its cover pictures the Mael brothers tied up and gagged.

title: Red (Taylor's Version)
label: Republic Records
personnel: Mike Meadows – guitar, synthesizer, vocals, mandolin, piano

tracks.t: I Knew You Were Trouble (Taylor's Version)
We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together (Taylor's Version)
Message In A Bottle (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
I Bet You Think About Me (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
The Very First Night (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
All Too Well (10 Minute Version) (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)

about: Taylor Swift's re-recording of her 2012 album Red, made after the dispute over ownership of her original masters. It adds previously unreleased songs from the vault, including a ten-minute version of All Too Well, and debuted at number one in the US.

title: Pop
label: Island Records
personnel: Bono – lead vocals, additional guitar The Edge – guitar, keyboards, backing vocals Adam Clayton – bass guitar Larry Mullen Jr. – drums, percussion

tracks.t: If God Will Send His Angels
If You Wear That Velvet Dress

about: U2 mixed alternative rock with techno and electronic dance styles on this record produced by Flood, Howie B and Steve Osborne. It topped charts in many countries, yet its overall sales were low for the band, who later voiced regret about the finished product.

title: Introspective
label: EMI-Manhattan Records

tracks.t: Always On My Mind / In My House

about: Pet Shop Boys built this album from extended tracks of six minutes or more, inverting the usual pattern of releasing singles first and remixes later. Several producers including Trevor Horn contributed, and it peaked at number two in the UK.

title: Pink Flag
label: Pinkflag
personnel: Bruce Gilbert – guitar, sleeve concept Robert Gotobed – drums Graham Lewis – bass guitar, backing vocals, sleeve concept Colin Newman – vocals, guitar, backing vocals
about: Wire's first album, produced by Mike Thorne and recorded at Advision Studios in London for Harvest. Well received at the time, it is now considered a key post-punk record and influenced later American hardcore punk.

title: Dire Straits
label: Vertigo
personnel: Mark Knopfler – vocals, lead and rhythm guitars David Knopfler – rhythm guitar, backing vocals John Illsley – bass guitar, backing vocals Pick Withers – drums
about: The first album by Dire Straits, produced by Muff Winwood and cut at Basing Street Studios in London. Driven by the hit Sultans of Swing, it peaked at number two in the US and number five in the UK, later going double platinum in both.

title: Mixed Up
label: Rhino Records
personnel: Robert Smith – vocals, guitar, six-string bass, keyboards Simon Gallup – bass
Porl Thompson – guitar, six-string bass Boris Williams – drums
Roger O'Donnell – keyboards Andy Anderson – drums

tracks.t: Why Can't I Be You? (Extended Mix-Remastered 2018)

about: A Fiction Records collection of reworked versions of earlier Cure hits, reflecting the dance and remix culture of the period. It also contained the new single Never Enough and was followed decades later by a second remix set, Torn Down.

title: October
label: Island Records
personnel: Bono – lead vocals The Edge – guitar, piano, backing vocals Adam Clayton – bass guitar Larry Mullen Jr. – drums

tracks.t: I Threw A Brick Through A Window

about: U2's follow-up to Boy, produced by Steve Lillywhite, reflects members' involvement with a Christian fellowship. Recording was rushed after Bono lost a case of draft lyrics on tour, and reviews on release were mixed.

title: The Empire Strikes Back (Original Soundtrack)
label: RSO
personnel: John Williams - Conductor London Symphony Orchestra

tracks.t: The Training Of A Jedi Knight
The Heroics Of Luke And Han

about: John Williams's score for the second Star Wars film, first issued by RSO in the US as a double LP shortly before the movie opened. Later editions included an abridged early CD and a 2018 remaster from Walt Disney Records.

title: Roxy - Tonight's The Night Live
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Neil Young – vocals, guitar, piano, harmonica Ben Keith – pedal steel guitar, slide guitar, vocals Nils Lofgren – piano, guitar, vocals Billy Talbot – bass
about: Recorded over three nights in September 1973 when the Roxy in Los Angeles reopened, with Neil Young backed by the Santa Monica Flyers. Because the shows came soon after the Tonight's the Night sessions, the set is made up almost entirely of songs from that record.

title: Almost Famous (Music From The Motion Picture)
label: Geffen Records

tracks.t: Todd Rundgren– It Wouldn't Have Made Any Difference
Yes– I've Seen All Good People : Your Move
Rod Stewart– Every Picture Tells A Story
The Allman Brothers Band– One Way Out
David Bowie– I'm Waiting For The Man
Thunderclap Newman– Something In The Air

about: The companion album to Cameron Crowe's film about a teenage rock journalist in the early 1970s. It gathers classic rock tracks by acts such as Led Zeppelin, Simon & Garfunkel, the Who and Elton John, plus a song by the film's fictional band Stillwater.

title: A Legendary Performer - Volume 3
label: RCA

tracks.t: Excerpts From Interview With Elvis And The Colonel

about: The third volume in RCA's Legendary Performer series of Elvis Presley compilations, released the year after his death. It mixes familiar recordings with material that had not previously appeared on an official RCA album.
vinylColor: Blue Border, Non-Embossed Jacket / Picture Disc

title: Station To Station
label: Parlophone
personnel: David Bowie – vocals, guitar, saxophone, Minimoog, Mellotron Carlos Alomar, Earl Slick – guitar
Warren Peace – vocals Harry Maslin – melodica, synthesiser, vibraphone
about: David Bowie's tenth studio album, recorded in Los Angeles and introducing his Thin White Duke persona. Its six long songs blend funk and soul with krautrock influences, bridging Young Americans and the Berlin period, and include Golden Years.

title: Rust Never Sleeps
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Neil Young – vocals, guitars, harmonica, organ, percussion Crazy Horse: Frank "Poncho" Sampedro – electric guitar, backing vocals Billy Talbot – bass, backing vocals Ralph Molina – drums, backing vocals

tracks.t: My My, Hey Hey (Out Of The Blue)
Hey Hey, My My (Into The Black)

about: Neil Young's album with Crazy Horse, built mainly from live recordings with overdubs. An acoustic first side contrasts with a loud electric second, and it is bookended by two versions of the song My My, Hey Hey.

title: The Mail Must Go Through
label: Mad About Records
about: A scarce West Coast funk LP by a group called The Cult, issued on Starburst Records, a label apparently based in Las Vegas, and recorded in Hollywood studios. Mostly raw funk with a few ballads, it became a collector's item and was reissued by Mad About Records in 2021.

title: Nine
label: Forever Living Originals
about: The fifth studio album by the anonymous British collective Sault, led by producer Inflo and singer Cleo Sol. It was offered only as a download and on streaming services and was deliberately withdrawn after 99 days.

title: Newport 1958
label: Columbia

tracks.t: My God Is Real (Yes, God Is Real)
He's Got The Whole World In His Hands
I'm Going To Live The Life I Sing About In My Song
Joshua Fit The Battle Of Jericho
His Eye Is On The Sparrow

about: A Columbia LP capturing the gospel singer's set at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival in Rhode Island. It documents Jackson performing spirituals and hymns before a jazz festival crowd, the same event at which she also appeared with Duke Ellington's orchestra.

title: No. 1 In Heaven
label: Elektra
personnel: Ron Mael – keyboards, synthesiser, vocals Russell Mael – vocals Keith Forsey – drums
Giorgio Moroder – synthesiser, vocoder Dan Wyman – synthesiser programming Chris Bennett, Dennis Young, Jack Moran – backing vocals
about: The eighth studio record by the Mael brothers' duo, made in Munich with producer Giorgio Moroder. It swapped their guitar-band approach for sequencers and synthesizers, and its single The Number One Song in Heaven gave them their first UK hit in years. Initially poorly reviewed, it is now seen as an influential synth-pop record.

title: Live In Montreux 1980
label: Ear Music Classics

tracks.t: If This World Was Mine / Ain't Nothing Like The Real Thing / Ain't No Mountain High Enough
How Sweet It Is (To Be Loved By You)
I Heard It Through The Grapevine
Inner City Blues (Make Me Wanna Holler)
If This World Was Mine / Ain't Nothing Like The Real Thing / Ain't No Mountain High Enough
How Sweet It Is (To Be Loved By You)
I Heard It Through The Grapevine
Inner City Blues (Make Me Wanna Holler)

about: A two-disc concert recording of Marvin Gaye performing at the Montreux Jazz Festival in Switzerland in 1980, issued in 2003. The set runs from his late-1970s funk material through a Tammi Terrell tribute medley and songs from What's Going On.

title: Risqué
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Alfa Anderson, Luci Martin – lead vocals
Fonzi Thornton – vocals Michelle Cobbs, Ullanda McCullough – backing vocals Nile Rodgers – guitar, vocals
Sammy Figueroa – percussion Robert Sabino, Andy Schwartz, Raymond Jones – keyboards Bernard Edwards – bass

tracks.t: Will You Cry (When You Hear This Song)

about: Chic's third studio album, produced by Nile Rodgers and Bernard Edwards for Atlantic. It contains Good Times, later heavily sampled in early hip hop, and reached the US top five while earning platinum certification. It is widely regarded as one of the strongest records of the disco era.

title: This Is Happening
label: DFA
personnel: James Murphy – vocals, guitar, drums, bass, piano, EMS VCS3 Putney, Korg Poly Ensemble, EMS PolySynthi, EMS Synthi A, Yamaha CS-60, Casio MT-68, percussion, Simmons, cowbell, Roland System 100, Synare, Wurlitzer electric piano, tambourine, Roland TR-606 Pat Mahoney – vocals, drums
about: The third LCD Soundsystem album, which James Murphy presented at the time as the group's farewell. Recorded in Los Angeles, it includes Drunk Girls and Dance Yrself Clean and became the band's highest-charting release up to then.

title: 24 Karat Hits!
label: Analogue Productions

tracks.t: Wear My Ring Around Your Neck

about: A greatest-hits collection issued by the audiophile label DCC Compact Classics as a gold-disc CD. It gathers 24 well-known Elvis Presley recordings such as Heartbreak Hotel, Hound Dog, Jailhouse Rock and Suspicious Minds.

title: A Rush Of Blood To The Head
label: Parlophone
personnel: Chris Martin – lead vocals, piano, acoustic guitar, rhythm guitar Jonny Buckland – guitar, backing vocals, twelve-string slide guitar Guy Berryman – bass guitar Will Champion – drums, percussion, backing vocals

tracks.t: God Put A Smile Upon Your Face
A Rush Of Blood To The Head

about: Coldplay's second studio album, co-produced by the band and Ken Nelson, leaning more on piano and electric guitar than their debut. It topped charts in many countries, sold in the tens of millions, and won Grammy awards, with singles including In My Place, The Scientist and Clocks.

title: New York
label: Sire Records
personnel: Lou Reed – lead and background vocals, guitar Mike Rathke – guitar Rob Wasserman – electric upright bass Fred Maher – drums
Moe Tucker – percussion Dion DiMucci, Jeffrey Lesser – backing vocals
about: Lou Reed's fifteenth solo studio album, released on Sire. Built on plain guitar-based rock, it carries pointed lyrics about social and political life in late-1980s New York, and Reed intended it to be heard straight through. It was a critical success, and Dirty Blvd. led the US modern rock chart.

title: Moanin'
label: Blue Note
personnel: Art Blakey – drums Lee Morgan – trumpet
Jymie Merritt – bass Benny Golson – tenor saxophone
about: A Blue Note hard bop album by Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers, recorded in October 1958 with Lee Morgan, Benny Golson, Bobby Timmons and Jymie Merritt. Its title track by Timmons became a jazz standard, and the record is among Blakey's best known.

title: Here
label: RCA
personnel: Alicia Keys – drum programming, Fender Rhodes, keyboards, Moog bass, piano, vocals, background vocals Roy Ayers – vibraphone, vocals Mark Batson – drum programming, keyboards Harold Lilly – drum programming, vocals
MusicManTy – bass, drums ASAP Rocky – vocals

tracks.t: Blended Family (What You Do For Love)

about: Alicia Keys' sixth studio album, released by RCA and recorded largely in New York. It drew generally favorable reviews, debuted at number two on the Billboard 200, and topped the R&B/hip-hop albums chart. Its singles were In Common and Blended Family (What You Do for Love).

title: Master Of Puppets
label: Blackened
personnel: James Hetfield – vocals, guitar Kirk Hammett – lead guitar Cliff Burton – bass, backing vocals Lars Ulrich – drums

tracks.t: The Thing That Should Not Be

about: Metallica's third studio album, recorded in Copenhagen with producer Flemming Rasmussen and released by Elektra. It was the final album with bassist Cliff Burton, who died later in 1986. Widely ranked among the greatest metal records, it was added to the US National Recording Registry in 2015.

title: Harvest
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Neil Young – vocals, guitar, piano, harmonica James Taylor – banjo guitar Linda Ronstadt – backing vocals David Crosby, Stephen Stills, Graham Nash – backing vocals London Symphony Orchestra – orchestra

tracks.t: Are You Ready For The Country?
The Needle And The Damage Done

about: Neil Young's fourth studio album, issued by Reprise with guest singers including Crosby, Stills, Nash, Linda Ronstadt and James Taylor. It became the top-selling US album of 1972 and yielded the number-one single Heart of Gold. It remains his best-selling record.

title: Everybody Else Is Doing It, So Why Can't We?
label: Island Records
personnel: Dolores O'Riordan – lead vocals, acoustic guitar Noel Hogan – lead guitar, backing vocals Mike Hogan – bass guitar Fergal Lawler – drums, percussion
about: The Cranberries' first full-length album, released by Island and produced by Stephen Street, with songs by Dolores O'Riordan and Noel Hogan. It reached number one in the UK and Ireland and includes Linger and Dreams, selling millions of copies worldwide.

title: So Far… The Best Of Sinéad O'Connor
label: Chrysalis

tracks.t: The Last Day Of Our Acquaintance
I Am Stretched On Your Grave
Success Has Made A Failure Of Our Home
You Made Me The Thief Of Your Heart
Just Like U Said It Would B

about: A greatest-hits set drawing on Sinead O'Connor's first four studio albums plus several collaborations. Released on Chrysalis, it was her last album for that label, and it charted in the top three in Ireland and inside the UK top 30.

title: Sound And Color
label: ATO Records
personnel: Brittany Howard vocals, guitar, vibraphone, percussion, keyboards Heath Fogg guitar, percussion Zac Cockrell bass, percussion Steve Johnson drums, percussion

tracks.t: Don't Wanna Fight No More (Live from Capitol Studio A)
Future People (Live from Capitol Studio A)
Over My Head (Live from Capitol Studio A)

about: Alabama Shakes' second studio album, released by ATO Records. Rooted in soul and Southern rock but more experimental than their debut, it entered the Billboard 200 at number one and collected several Grammy awards, with Don't Wanna Fight as its leading single.

title: Surfer Rosa
label: 4AD
personnel: Black Francis – vocals, rhythm guitar, acoustic guitar Kim Deal – bass, vocals Joey Santiago – lead guitar David Lovering – drums
about: The Pixies' first full-length studio album, issued by 4AD and recorded in Boston with Steve Albini engineering. Its raw, loud production and songs such as Gigantic and Where Is My Mind? earned acclaim, and it later went gold in the US and influenced many alternative rock acts.

title: Route 666
label: Not On Label
personnel: John "Bubble" Terhorst – Bass, Vocals, Guitar Ray "4Skins" Sage – Drums, Sampler Jim "The Man" Fourniadis – Engineer, Producer Roy "Wild Man" Edroso – Guitar, Vocals, Bass
about: The first album by the New York noise-punk group, released on Race Age Records. Trouser Press singled out its silkscreened sleeve as one of the best covers of the decade while describing the music as chaotic, humorous guitar noise.

title: Low In High School
label: Étienne
personnel: Morrissey – lead vocals Jesse Tobias – guitars
Gustavo Manzur – keyboards Boz Boorer – guitars

tracks.t: My Love, I'd Do Anything For You
Jacky's Only Happy When She's Up On The Stage
The Girl From Tel-Aviv Who Wouldn't Kneel
All The Young People Must Fall In Love
Who Will Protect Us From The Police?

about: Morrissey's eleventh solo studio album, produced by Joe Chiccarelli and released through BMG after sessions in France and Italy. It entered the UK chart at number five but received mixed reviews, and its cover image prompted reports about retailers refusing to stock it.

title: Rocket To Russia
label: Sire
personnel: Joey Ramone – lead vocals Johnny Ramone – guitar Dee Dee Ramone – bass guitar, backing vocals Tommy Ramone – drums, producer

tracks.t: Why Is It Always This Way

about: The Ramones' third studio album on Sire, the last to feature founding drummer Tommy Ramone. With a bigger budget, it leaned toward surf and bubblegum pop and included covers of Do You Wanna Dance? and Surfin' Bird. It reached number 49 in the US.

title: Two Quid Deal?
label: Stax Records
personnel: Thomas Crimble - bass, vocals, keyboards, harmonica Robert 'Bob' James - saxophone, flute, guitar, vocals Krzysztof Henryk Juszkiewicz - organ, piano, accordion, harpsichord, mellotron, vocals, trumpet Giles 'Alvin' Pope - drums, percussion
Nick Graham - vocals, keyboards, bass, flute
about: The third LP by the London progressive rock band and their first for Transatlantic Records, released on its Big T imprint. It mixes progressive rock with jazz-rock touches.

title: Smell The Remains
label: Dom DOM
personnel: Amazon Bambi, Baby J., Cheez-it-Ritz, D.K., Dr
Id, Ju Suk Reet Meet, White Mohamed – Drums, Voice, Effects, Organ, Bass, Guitar, Saxophone, Tape

tracks.t: Forest Fire In Your Left Elbow

about: A release by Smegma, the experimental noise and free improvisation group formed in Pasadena, California, in 1973. It appears in the band's discography as a 1988 title, though further details about it could not be confirmed.

title: International Hotel Las Vegas, Nevada August 26, 1969
label: RCA Records

tracks.t: Baby What You Want Me To Do

about: A double LP from RCA/Legacy presenting Elvis Presley's complete midnight show of August 26, 1969, at the International Hotel in Las Vegas. It was released alongside the Live 1969 box set marking the 50th anniversary of his return to live performance.

title: Some Nights
label: Fueled By Ramen
personnel: Jack Antonoff – guitars, vocals, bass , drums, percussion Andrew Dost – keyboards, piano, celeste, synthesizer, glockenspiel, guitar, bass, accordion, drums, percussion, trumpet, flugelhorn, vocals Nate Ruess – lead vocals, background vocals
about: The second and last studio album by fun., released on Fueled by Ramen and largely produced by Jeff Bhasker. Mixing indie pop, theatrical rock and hip-hop production, it contained the chart-topping single We Are Young and was certified triple platinum in the US.

title: Discovery
label: ADA
personnel: Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo Thomas Bangalter – vocals, vocoders, sequencers, sampling, synthesizers, Wurlitzer electric piano, guitars, bass, talkbox, drum machines
about: Daft Punk's second studio album, recorded in their Paris home studio and drawing on disco, garage house and R&B with heavy sampling. Paired with the anime film Interstella 5555, it produced One More Time and other singles, and its reputation rose greatly over time.

title: Living In The USA
label: Asylum Records
personnel: Linda Ronstadt – vocals Dan Dugmore – guitar
Waddy Wachtel – guitar, vocals Don Grolnick – piano , organ
Kenny Edwards – bass, vocals Russ Kunkel – drums, congas Peter Asher – vocals, cowbell, tambourine, shaker, sleigh bells

tracks.t: When I Grow Too OId To Dream

about: Linda Ronstadt's ninth studio album, produced by Peter Asher. It went to number one in the US and includes covers such as Chuck Berry's Back in the U.S.A. and Smokey Robinson's Ooo Baby Baby.

title: Uh Oh ... No Brakes!
label: Twin/Tone Records
personnel: Kim Kane – Rhythm guitar, backing vocals Marshall Keith – Lead guitar, keyboards, backing vocals Dan Palenski – drums, percussion, backing vocals Mark Noone – Lead vocals, guitar John Chumbris – Bass guitar, keyboards, backing vocals, guitar

tracks.t: The Brain That Refused To Die

about: A 1985 album by Washington, D.C. garage and punk band the Slickee Boys, released by Twin/Tone and produced by the group. Almost half of it consists of new versions of older songs, alongside covers of the Dogs, the Squires and Perry Como.

title: Never Say Never
label: 415 Records
personnel: Debora Iyall – vocals Peter Woods – guitar Benjamin Bossi – saxophone Frank Zincavage – bass Larry Carter – drums, percussion
about: A four-song EP by San Francisco new wave band Romeo Void, issued by 415 Records. Its title track became a dance chart hit in 1982 and is the group's signature song; the other songs are In the Dark, Present Tense and Not Safe.

title: Screen Violence
label: EMI
personnel: Lauren Mayberry – vocals, keyboards, percussion Iain Cook – keyboards, guitar, bass Martin Doherty – keyboards, guitar, bass, vocals
about: The fourth album by Scottish synth-pop trio Chvrches, made partly remotely during the pandemic and steeped in horror film imagery. It features a guest vocal from Robert Smith of the Cure on How Not to Drown.

title: American Beauty
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Jerry Garcia – guitar, pedal steel, piano, vocals Mickey Hart – percussion
Bill Kreutzmann – drums Phil Lesh – bass, guitar, piano, vocals Pigpen (Ron McKernan) – harmonica, vocals Bob Weir – guitar, vocals
about: The Grateful Dead's fifth studio album, released months after Workingman's Dead and sharing its acoustic, harmony-driven Americana sound. It includes Truckin', Ripple, Box of Rain and Sugar Magnolia.

title: Highway 61 Revisited
label: Columbia
personnel: Bob Dylan – vocals, guitar, harmonica, piano, siren whistle Mike Bloomfield – electric guitar Al Kooper – organ, piano

tracks.t: It Takes A Lot To Laugh, It Takes A Train To Cry

about: Bob Dylan's sixth studio album, produced by Bob Johnston and Tom Wilson, extended the electric rock approach of his previous record, with only the long closer Desolation Row played acoustically. Named after the highway linking his Minnesota birthplace to the musical South, it reached the top five in the US and UK.

title: Give 'Em Enough Rope
label: Epic
personnel: Joe Strummer – lead and backing vocals, rhythm guitar Mick Jones – lead guitar, backing vocals, lead vocals on "Stay Free" Paul Simonon – bass guitar, backing vocals Topper Headon – drums

tracks.t: All The Young Punks (New Boots And Contracts)

about: The Clash's second studio album was produced by Sandy Pearlman and issued by CBS Records. It climbed to number two in the UK and became the first Clash album released in the United States, arriving there ahead of the American edition of their debut.

title: Strange Days
label: Elektra Records
personnel: Jim Morrison – vocals, moog synthesizer Ray Manzarek – keyboards, marimba Robby Krieger – guitar John Densmore – drums

tracks.t: I Can't See Your Face In My Mind

about: Released by Elektra just eight months after their debut, the Doors' second studio album was produced by Paul A. Rothchild. It reached number three in the US, went platinum and yielded the singles People Are Strange and Love Me Two Times.

title: Zaba
label: Harvest Records
personnel: David Bayley – producer David Wrench – mixing Glass Animals – primary artist, engineer Joseph Hartwell Jones – engineer
about: The debut studio album by English band Glass Animals was produced by singer Dave Bayley with Paul Epworth as executive producer. Its psychedelic indie pop draws on tropical percussion and a children's book about a jungle, and it did especially well in Australia.

title: Power, Corruption & Lies
label: London Records
personnel: Bernard Sumner – vocals, guitars, melodica, synthesizers and programming Peter Hook – 4- and 6-stringed bass and electronic percussion Stephen Morris – drums, synthesizers and programming Gillian Gilbert – synthesizers, guitars and programming
about: New Order's self-produced second studio album, issued by Factory Records, leaned further into synthesisers and electronic rhythms than their debut Movement. Peter Saville's sleeve later appeared on a Royal Mail stamp, and the record is widely ranked among the best albums of the 1980s.

title: Black Holes And Revelations
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Matthew Bellamy – vocals, lead and rhythm guitars, piano, synthesizers Christopher Wolstenholme – bass, vocals, bass Dominic Howard – drums, percussion
about: Muse's fourth studio album, co-produced with Rich Costey, entered the charts at number one in the UK and several other countries and made the US top ten. It was shortlisted for the Mercury Prize and has sold several million copies worldwide.

title: Crash
label: Asylum Records
about: Charli XCX's fifth studio album, released through Asylum and Atlantic, closed out her deal with Asylum. Trading her experimental hyperpop leanings for polished dance-pop, it topped the charts in the UK, Ireland and Australia.

title: Topical Dancer
label: Deewee
about: The first full-length album by Belgian duo Charlotte Adigéry and Bolis Pupul came out on the Deewee label and was co-written and co-produced with Soulwax. Sung in several languages, its songs tackle racism, identity and abuse over playful electronic grooves.

title: Fear Of Music
label: Warner Bros Records
personnel: David Byrne – lead vocals, guitar Jerry Harrison – guitar, backing vocals, keyboards Tina Weymouth – bass guitar, backing vocals Chris Frantz – drums
about: Talking Heads' third studio album was co-produced with Brian Eno and recorded in New York in spring 1979. Issued by Sire, it featured the singles Life During Wartime, I Zimbra and Cities and is often counted among the band's strongest work.

title: Marquee Moon
label: Elektra
personnel: Billy Ficca – drums Richard Lloyd – guitar, vocals Fred Smith – bass guitar, vocals Tom Verlaine – guitar, keyboards, lead vocals
about: Television's debut studio album, released by Elektra, captured the New York band's interlocking twin-guitar style developed at CBGB. Though modest commercially in the US, it became one of the most admired records of the punk and new wave era.

title: Unknown Pleasures
label: Factory
personnel: Ian Curtis – vocals Bernard Sumner – guitar, keyboards Peter Hook – bass guitar, vocals Stephen Morris – drums, percussion
