about: Joy Division's debut studio album was issued by Factory Records and produced by Martin Hannett, who recorded it over a few weekends at Strawberry Studios in Stockport. Its famous Peter Saville cover reproduces a plot of radio pulsar signals.

title: Unlimited Love
label: Warner Records
personnel: Anthony Kiedis – lead vocals Flea – bass, piano, trumpet John Frusciante – electric guitar, vocals, synthesizer, acoustic guitar Chad Smith – drums, percussion, tambourine, bass, shaker
about: The Red Hot Chili Peppers' twelfth studio album marked the return of guitarist John Frusciante and producer Rick Rubin. Arriving six years after The Getaway, it topped the charts in many countries, including the United States.

title: Fugazi (7 Songs)
label: Dischord Records
personnel: Ian MacKaye – vocals, guitar Guy Picciotto – vocals Joe Lally – bass Brendan Canty – drums
about: Fugazi's debut release, often called 7 Songs, is an EP issued on vinyl by Dischord and produced by Ted Niceley with the band. Ian MacKaye handled all guitar parts, and the record includes Waiting Room, frequently cited as the group's best-known song.

title: A Moon Shaped Pool
label: XL Recordings
personnel: Colin Greenwood Jonny Greenwood Ed O'Brien Philip Selway Thom Yorke

tracks.t: Tinker Tailor Soldier Sailor Rich Man Poor Man Beggar Man Thief

about: Radiohead's ninth studio album, produced by Nigel Godrich, appeared digitally in May 2016 and in shops that June via XL Recordings. It features string and choir arrangements by Jonny Greenwood and includes long-gestating songs such as True Love Waits and Burn the Witch.

title: Horses
label: Legacy
personnel: Patti Smith – vocals Jay Dee Daugherty – drums Lenny Kaye – lead guitar Ivan Král – bass guitar, guitar Richard Sohl – piano
about: Patti Smith's debut studio album was produced by John Cale and recorded at Electric Lady Studios for Arista. It reached the Billboard top 50, drew wide critical praise, and was later added to the Library of Congress National Recording Registry.

title: Disintegration
label: Fiction Records
personnel: Robert Smith – vocals, guitars, keyboards Simon Gallup – bass guitar, keyboards Roger O'Donnell – keyboards Porl Thompson – guitars Boris Williams – drums, percussion

tracks.t: The Same Deep Water As You

about: The Cure's eighth studio album, recorded with co-producer David M. Allen at Hookend studios in Oxfordshire and released by Fiction, brought the band back to the brooding gothic rock of their early 1980s records.

title: Folklore
label: Republic Records
personnel: Taylor Swift – vocals Aaron Dessner – piano, guitar, Mellotron, OP-1, synth bass, percussion, bass, synthesizer, keyboards
Evan Smith – saxophone, keyboards, flute, guitar Yuki Numata Resnick – viola, violin
Jack Antonoff – drums, percussion, guitar, keyboards, piano, bass, vocals
about: Taylor Swift's eighth studio album was surprise-released through Republic Records after being made during pandemic lockdown, largely with Aaron Dessner and Jack Antonoff. It was the top-selling US album of 2020 and won the Grammy for Album of the Year.

title: Cut
label: Island Records
personnel: Ari Up – vocals Viv Albertine – guitar Tessa Pollitt – bass guitar

tracks.t: I Heard It Through The Grapevine

about: The Slits' debut album was produced by Dennis Bovell and recorded at Ridge Farm Studios in Sussex. It merges punk energy with reggae and dub rhythms and touches of art pop.

title: In Utero (2013 Mix)
label: UMe
personnel: Kurt Cobain – guitar, vocals, art direction, design, photography Krist Novoselic – bass guitar Dave Grohl – drums, percussion, backing vocals

tracks.t: Frances Farmer Will Have Her Revenge On Seattle

about: Nirvana's third and last studio album was recorded with Steve Albini for a rawer sound than Nevermind and topped the US and UK charts. The 2013 Mix refers to a fresh mix made for the album's 20th anniversary reissue that September.

title: Dry
label: Too Pure
personnel: PJ Harvey – vocals, guitar, violin Steve Vaughan – bass Rob Ellis – drums, vocals, harmonium
about: PJ Harvey's debut studio album was released by Too Pure and recorded by her trio at a small studio in Yeovil. Early copies came with a bonus set of demo versions, and the album was later issued in the US by Indigo.

title: Uh Huh Her
label: Island Records
personnel: PJ Harvey – vocals, guitars, bass, piano, melodica, accordion, autoharp Rob Ellis – drums, percussion, backing vocals Head – backing vocals

tracks.t: The Life And Death Of Mr. Badmouth
The Darker Days Of Me And Him

about: PJ Harvey's sixth studio album, released by Island, was written, played and produced almost entirely by Harvey herself over two years, with Rob Ellis adding final drums. It became her best-charting album in the United States.

title: Black Celebration
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Alan Wilder Andrew Fletcher David Gahan Martin Gore
about: Depeche Mode's fifth studio album, released by Mute and recorded in London and West Berlin, was produced with Daniel Miller and Gareth Jones. Critics often treat it as the opening of the band's celebrated late-1980s run.

title: Death Of A Bachelor
label: Fueled By Ramen
personnel: Brendon Urie – vocals, guitar, bass, keyboards, drums, background vocals

tracks.t: Don't Threaten Me With A Good Time
The Good, The Bad And The Dirty

about: Panic! at the Disco's fifth studio album was effectively a Brendon Urie solo project and the first without drummer Spencer Smith. It gave the band its first US number-one album and received a Grammy nomination for Best Rock Album.

title: Pressure Drop - The Golden Tracks
label: Purple Pyramid
about: A compilation of recordings by the Jamaican group Toots and the Maytals, taking its name from their song Pressure Drop. AllMusic lists a January 2011 release lasting roughly an hour; it was later reissued on coloured vinyl by Cleopatra Records.

title: Boys & Girls
label: ATO Records
personnel: Brittany Howard – lead vocals, guitar, piano, percussion Heath Fogg – guitar, backing vocals, percussion Zac Cockrell – bass, backing vocals, guitar Steve Johnson – drums, backing vocals, percussion
about: Alabama Shakes' debut studio album, released by ATO Records and co-produced with Andrija Tokic, reached the top ten in the US and number three in the UK. A tenth anniversary edition added a live KCRW session.

title: Entertainment!
label: Matador
personnel: Jon King – vocals, melodica Andy Gill – guitar, vocals Dave Allen – bass guitar, vocals Hugo Burnham – drums
about: Gang of Four's debut album, issued by EMI and in North America by Warner Bros., blends punk with funk and dub. Its politically charged lyrics and artwork helped make it a landmark of post-punk.

title: Plans
label: Music On Vinyl
personnel: Ben Gibbard – vocals, guitars, piano Nick Harmer – bass Jason McGerr – drums Chris Walla – guitars, keyboards, production

tracks.t: Different Names For The Same Thing
I Will Follow You Into The Dark
Your Heart Is An Empty Room

about: Death Cab for Cutie's fifth studio album and first for major label Atlantic was produced by guitarist Chris Walla. It reached the US top five, earned a Grammy nomination, and included I Will Follow You into the Dark.

title: Wrecker
label: Estrus Records
personnel: Dave Crider - guitar, vocals Ledge Morrisette - bass Aaron Roeder - drums John Mortensen - guitar, vocals
about: The second full-length record by Bellingham garage rockers Mono Men, released on Estrus. Recorded at Egg Studios with engineer Conrad Uno, it explores a darker, minor-key take on garage rock.

title: Trompe Le Monde
label: 4AD
personnel: Black Francis – vocals, guitar Kim Deal – bass guitar, vocals David Lovering – drums Joey Santiago – lead guitar

tracks.t: Bird Dream Of The Olympus Mons

about: The fourth Pixies studio album, produced by Gil Norton and recorded in Burbank, Paris and London. It was the band's last record before their split two years later and the final one with bassist Kim Deal, reaching number 7 in the UK.

title: Pixies (EP)
label: Vinyl Lovers
personnel: Black Francis – vocals, guitars David Lovering – drums Kim Deal – bass, vocals Joey Santiago – lead guitars
about: An EP collecting the remaining tracks from the 1987 Purple Tape demo session that Gary Smith recorded at Fort Apache Studios in Boston. Songs from the same session had earlier formed Come On Pilgrim; this set was issued by SpinART in the US and Cooking Vinyl in the UK.

title: (GI)
label: Rhino Records
personnel: Darby Crash – lead vocals Pat Smear – guitar, backing vocals Lorna Doom – bass guitar, backing vocals Don Bolles – drums, backing vocals
about: The sole studio album by Los Angeles punk band the Germs, issued on Slash Records with Joan Jett as producer. The title abbreviates Germs Incognito, a name used to get gigs, and the record is widely regarded as one of the earliest full-length hardcore punk albums.

title: Everything Not Saved Will Be Lost: Part 2
label: Warner Records
personnel: Yannis Philippakis – vocals, guitar, bass Jimmy Smith – guitar, keyboards Jack Bevan – drums Edwin Congreave – keyboards, synthesizers, bass
about: Foals' sixth studio album and the second half of a two-part project begun earlier in 2019. Co-produced by the band and Brett Shaw, it gave Foals their first number one on the UK Albums Chart and was keyboardist Edwin Congreave's final album with them.

title: Wet Leg
label: Domino
personnel: Rhian Teasdale – vocals, guitar, writing Hester Chambers – guitar, vocals, writing
about: The self-titled first album by Isle of Wight band Wet Leg, released by Domino and mainly produced by Dan Carey. It topped the UK and Australian charts, was shortlisted for the Mercury Prize, and won the Grammy for Best Alternative Music Album.

title: Wish You Were Here
label: Pink Floyd Records
personnel: David Gilmour – vocals, guitars, EMS Synthi AKS, bass, harmonica Roger Waters – vocals, bass, EMS VCS 3, guitar, harmonica Nick Mason – drums, percussion, timpani, cymbals Richard Wright – Hammond organ, ARP String Ensemble, Minimoog, Steinway piano, EMS VCS 3, Hohner Clavinet D6, Wurlitzer EP-200 electric piano, Rhodes piano, harmonica, backing vocals
about: Pink Floyd's ninth studio album, recorded at EMI Studios in London as the follow-up to The Dark Side of the Moon. Its centrepiece, Shine On You Crazy Diamond, honours founding member Syd Barrett, and the record reached number one in both Britain and the United States.

title: Ahora Me Da Pena
label: World Circuit
about: A limited 12-inch vinyl release by Buena Vista Social Club, issued by World Circuit/BMG as a Record Store Day 2022 exclusive. It centres on the song Ahora Me Da Pena, a recording connected to the ensemble's 1990s Havana sessions.

title: Pornography
label: Elektra
personnel: Robert Smith – vocals, guitar, keyboards, cello Simon Gallup – bass guitar, keyboards Lol Tolhurst – drums, keyboards
about: The Cure's fourth studio album, recorded at RAK Studios in London with co-producer Phil Thornalley. Initially poorly received by critics, it reached number 8 in the UK and has since come to be regarded as a landmark of gothic rock.

title: Oh, No! It's Devo
label: Warner Records
personnel: Mark Mothersbaugh – lead and background vocals, keyboards Gerald Casale – lead and background vocals, bass guitar, keyboards Bob Casale – guitar, keyboards, backing vocals Bob Mothersbaugh – guitar, backing vocals Alan Myers – drums
about: Devo's fifth studio album, produced by Roy Thomas Baker for Warner Bros. It leans more heavily on programmed synthesizers and drum machines than its predecessor, and includes the singles Peek-a-Boo! and That's Good.

title: Acoustics
label: Blackheart Records

tracks.t: You Don’t Know What You’ve Got
I Hate Myself For Loving You

about: A limited black vinyl LP issued for Record Store Day 2022 through Blackheart Records and Sony. It contains eight acoustic renditions of Joan Jett and Blackhearts songs, two of them recorded live in Los Angeles, including a cover of the Replacements' Androgynous.

title: Complete Captured Live
label: Parlophone
about: An expanded edition of Peter Tosh's concert recording Captured Live, documenting his performance at the Greek Theatre in Los Angeles. The set runs about an hour and a half and presents the reggae singer's full show rather than the shorter original selection.

title: Unsuitable For Airplay - The Lost KFAI Concert
label: Rhino Records
personnel: Tommy Stinson – bass guitar Bob Stinson – lead guitar

tracks.t: All Day And All Of The Night

about: An archival live recording by the Replacements of a concert originally broadcast on the Minneapolis community radio station KFAI. Rhino issued it as a Record Store Day 2022 double vinyl release, and it reached number 16 on the US vinyl albums chart.

title: Come Away With Me
label: Blue Note
personnel: Norah Jones – vocals, piano, Wurlitzer electric piano Sam Yahel – Hammond B-3 organ Jesse Harris, Adam Levy, Kevin Breit, Adam Rogers, Tony Scherr – guitar Lee Alexander – bass

tracks.t: I've Got To See You Again

about: Norah Jones's first album, released on Blue Note Records. A slow-building success, it eventually topped the US chart, sold more than 27 million copies worldwide and won several Grammys in 2003, including Album of the Year.

title: Funky Kingston
label: Warner Bros Records
personnel: Frederick "Toots" Hibbert - vocals Ralphus "Raleigh" Gordon, Nathaniel "Jerry" Matthias - vocals Radcliffe "Dougie" Bryan - guitar
Neville Hinds - keyboards Jackie Jackson - bass

tracks.t: Love Is Gonna Let Me Down

about: The 1975 US edition of Funky Kingston, assembled by Island from earlier Maytals material, kept only three songs from the 1973 Jamaican album and added tracks from In the Dark plus Pressure Drop. This version became a celebrated reggae introduction for American listeners.

title: Bustin' + Dronin'
label: Parlophone
personnel: Damon Albarn Graham Coxon Alex James Dave Rowntree

tracks.t: Death Of A Party (Well Blurred Remix)
On Your Own (Crouch End Broadway Mix)
Death Of A Party (Billy Whiskers Mix)

about: A double album first issued in Japan, pairing remixes of songs from Blur's self-titled album by artists such as Thurston Moore, William Orbit and Moby with a live session recorded for John Peel. It later appeared in limited quantities in the UK and US.

title: Roaring Lion
label: Pressure Sounds

tracks.t: Truths And Rights Jah Lion & The Upsetters
Upsetters Shuffle (Dub Plate Mix) The Upsetters
Roaring Lion Jah Lion & The Upsetters
Pride Augustus Pablo And The Upsetters

about: An LP by the Memphis rock band Larry Raspberry and the Highsteppers, issued in the US on Backroom Records and recorded at Ardent Studios in Memphis. It mixes band originals with covers such as Hot Burrito and a Highway 61 and Good Rockin' Tonight medley.

title: The Way I Feel About You EP
label: Warner Bros. Records

The Way I Feel About You (Club Dub)
The Way I Feel About You (Dream Inst)

about: A Karyn White release taken from her second album Ritual of Love on Warner Bros. The song reached number 12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and number five on the US R&B chart, with a minor showing in the UK.

title: I'm The One
label: Atlantic
about: An Atlantic studio album by Roberta Flack that reached number 59 on the Billboard 200 and number 16 on the R&B albums chart. It includes Making Love, the theme from the film of that name, which became a top-15 pop hit.

title: Mardi Gras
label: Fantasy
about: Creedence Clearwater Revival's seventh and last album, made as a trio after Tom Fogerty's exit, with Stu Cook and Doug Clifford writing and singing some songs. It went gold and produced Sweet Hitch-Hiker and Someday Never Comes, but reviews were poor and the band split later that year.

title: Workingman's Dead
label: Warner Bros. Records
about: The Grateful Dead's fourth studio album, cut quickly in San Francisco in early 1970, swapped psychedelic jamming for country and folk-influenced songs by Jerry Garcia and Robert Hunter with close vocal harmonies. Released by Warner Bros., it eventually went platinum.

title: MCMLXXXIV (1984)
label: Warner Records
about: Van Halen's sixth album, produced by Ted Templeman and recorded at Eddie Van Halen's 5150 studio, added prominent synthesizers to the band's hard rock. Jump became their only US number one single, and the album, the last with David Lee Roth for decades, was certified Diamond.

artist: Chet Baker, Art Pepper & Phil Urso
title: Picture of Health (Playboys)
label: Pacific Jazz
about: A Pacific Jazz session recorded in Hollywood in October 1956 by trumpeter Chet Baker and alto saxophonist Art Pepper, with Phil Urso on tenor saxophone. Most tunes were written by Jimmy Heath, and a 1961 reissue with a new cover was retitled Picture of Heath.
artistKey: Chet Baker, Art Pepper & Phil Urso

title: Thriller
label: Mobile Fidelity Sound Lab
about: Michael Jackson's sixth studio album, co-produced with Quincy Jones, blended pop, funk, rock and post-disco. It spawned seven singles, won eight Grammy Awards including Album of the Year, and is widely cited as the best-selling album of all time.

title: Piñata Beats
label: Madlib Invazion
about: An instrumental companion to Piñata, Madlib's 2014 collaboration with rapper Freddie Gibbs, presenting the producer's beats without the vocals. It came out digitally in early June 2014, followed by a vinyl pressing on Madlib Invazion.

title: Wings At The Speed Of Sound
label: Capitol Records
about: The fifth Wings album, recorded at Abbey Road and produced by Paul McCartney, gave every band member at least one lead vocal. It topped the US Billboard 200, and its singles Silly Love Songs and Let 'Em In were transatlantic top-five hits.

title: First Take
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: Hey, That's No Way To Say Goodbye
The First Time I Ever Saw Your Face
Ballad Of The Sad Young Men

about: Roberta Flack's debut, produced by Joel Dorn and recorded in New York for Atlantic. It became a belated hit after The First Time Ever I Saw Your Face featured in the 1971 film Play Misty for Me, sending both song and album to number one in the US.

title: Shades of Blue
label: Blue Note
about: A project in which producer Madlib reworked and reinterpreted recordings from the Blue Note Records vaults, released by Blue Note in 2003. Critics responded well, and it reached number 13 on Billboard's jazz albums chart.

title: Music For The Masses
label: Rhino Records
about: Depeche Mode's sixth album, co-produced with David Bascombe and released by Mute and Sire, saw Alan Wilder take a leading production role. It produced four singles and its tour, ending at the Rose Bowl in 1988, cemented the band's US breakthrough.

title: Oh Death
label: Rocket Recordings
about: The fourth studio album by the masked Swedish psychedelic collective Goat, issued by Rocket Recordings as their first new record in six years. It continues their mix of African-influenced rhythms, fuzzy bass, saxophone and chanted group vocals, led by the single Under No Nation.

title: Hounds Of Love
label: Fish People
personnel: Hounds Of Love The Ninth Wave

tracks.t: Running Up That Hill (A Deal With God)

about: Kate Bush's fifth album, self-produced for EMI, pairs a side of individual songs with The Ninth Wave, a conceptual suite about a woman lost at sea. Led by Running Up That Hill, it topped the UK chart and is her best-selling studio record.

title: New Adventures In Hi-Fi
label: Craft Recordings

tracks.t: How The West Was Won And Where It Got Us

about: R.E.M.'s tenth studio album, produced with Scott Litt for Warner Bros. Much of it was captured on the road during the band's 1995 Monster tour. It topped the UK chart, reached number two in the US, and yielded singles including E-Bow the Letter.

title: Evermore
label: Republic Records
about: Taylor Swift's ninth studio album, issued by surprise through Republic Records months after Folklore. Made mostly with Aaron Dessner, it opened at number one on the Billboard 200, spawned the chart-topping single Willow, and earned an Album of the Year Grammy nomination.

title: Wish
label: Elektra
personnel: Robert Smith – voice, guitar, 6-string bass, keyboards

tracks.t: From The Edge Of The Deep Green Sea

about: The Cure's ninth studio album, released on Fiction in the UK and Elektra in the US and co-produced by David M. Allen. It entered the UK chart at number one, peaked at two in America, and included the hit Friday I'm in Love.

label: Warner Records

Scott Thurston – rhythm guitar, backing vocals, harmonica

about: A Warner live release documenting Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers' 20-night residency at San Francisco's Fillmore in early 1997, drawn mostly from the final six shows. Produced by Mike Campbell and Ryan Ulyate, the deluxe set runs to four CDs and reached number 35 in the US.

title: Upstairs At Eric's
label: Mobile Fidelity Sound Lab

tracks.t: I Before E Except After C

about: The first studio album by the synth-pop duo of Alison Moyet and Vince Clarke, known as Yaz in North America. Recorded at London's Blackwing Studios and issued by Mute, it reached number two in the UK and features the singles Only You, Don't Go and Situation.

title: Wave
label: Arista

tracks.t: So You Want To Be (A Rock 'N' Roll Star)

about: Patti Smith's fourth studio album and the last credited to the Patti Smith Group, produced by Todd Rundgren for Arista. It includes Frederick, Dancing Barefoot and a Byrds cover, and peaked at number 18 on the Billboard 200.

title: Beggars Banquet
label: London Records
about: The Rolling Stones' seventh studio album and their first produced by Jimmy Miller, released by Decca and London. It moved the band from psychedelia back toward blues and roots rock and was the final Stones album issued while Brian Jones was alive.

title: Everybody Knows This Is Nowhere
label: Reprise Records
about: Neil Young's second studio album and his first made with Crazy Horse, released by Reprise. Co-produced with David Briggs, it contains extended guitar pieces such as Down by the River and Cowgirl in the Sand, along with Cinnamon Girl, and later went platinum.

title: Pussy Whipped
label: Bikini Kill Records
about: Bikini Kill's first full-length studio album, issued by Kill Rock Stars and recorded in 1992 with Stuart Hallerman. A short, raw punk record central to the riot grrrl movement, it became the group's best-charting release on the UK independent chart.

title: Growing Up
label: Epitaph
personnel: Eloise Wong Lucia de la Garza Mila de la Garza
about: The debut studio album by Los Angeles punk band the Linda Lindas, released on Epitaph. Produced by Carlos de la Garza, the father of two members, it mixes punk and power pop and drew generally favorable reviews.

title: Piñata
label: Madlib Invazion
about: The first full-length collaboration between rapper Freddie Gibbs and producer Madlib, released on Madlib Invazion with every beat by Madlib. It followed three EPs, features guests such as Raekwon, Danny Brown and Earl Sweatshirt, and was widely praised by critics.

title: A Divine Symmetry (An Alternative Journey Through Hunky Dory)
label: Parlophone
personnel: David Bowie – saxophone, 12-string acoustic guitar, piano
about: A single-LP alternate take on David Bowie's Hunky Dory, made of different mixes and early versions of the album's songs. It first appeared within the Divine Symmetry box set of November 2022 before getting its own vinyl release through Parlophone in February 2023.

title: Homework
label: Soma Quality Recordings
about: The debut studio album by French electronic duo Daft Punk, released on Virgin and Soma. Self-produced by Thomas Bangalter and Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo, it blended house, techno and funk and produced singles such as Da Funk and Around the World.

title: American Idiot
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Billie Joe Armstrong – guitar, lead vocals

tracks.t: Wake Me Up When September Ends

about: Green Day's seventh studio album, a punk rock opera about a disaffected suburban youth set against post-9/11 America. Produced with Rob Cavallo for Reprise, it became the band's first Billboard 200 number one and won the Grammy for Best Rock Album.

title: Dookie
label: Reprise Records
about: Green Day's third studio album and their first on a major label, Reprise, produced with Rob Cavallo. Featuring Longview, Basket Case and When I Come Around, it brought pop punk into the mainstream, sold over 20 million copies and won a Grammy.

title: Cracker Island
label: Parlophone
about: The eighth studio album by virtual band Gorillaz, mainly produced with Greg Kurstin. Guests include Stevie Nicks, Thundercat, Tame Impala, Bad Bunny and Beck. It debuted at number one in the UK and was nominated for a Grammy.

title: Give Up
label: Sub Pop
about: The only studio album by the Postal Service, the electronic pop project of Ben Gibbard and Jimmy Tamborello, released on Sub Pop. Boosted by Such Great Heights, it went platinum and ranks among the label's biggest sellers.

title: The Linda Lindas
label: In The Red Recordings
personnel: Bela Salazar Eloise Wong Lucia de la Garza Mila de la Garza
about: The self-titled debut EP by Los Angeles punk group the Linda Lindas, released independently in late 2020. It came out before the band's viral library performance and its later deal with Epitaph.
vinylColor: Blue & Green [Bela - Color Inside Of Color In Sea Blue And Coke Bottle Green]

title: Blood Sugar Sex Magik
label: Warner Bros. Records
about: The Red Hot Chili Peppers' fifth studio album, produced by Rick Rubin and recorded in a Los Angeles mansion. Their first Warner Bros. release, it featured Give It Away and Under the Bridge, peaked at number three in the US and sold over 14 million copies.

title: Atlas
label: Sweat It Out!
about: The debut studio album by Australian electronic trio Rüfüs, later called Rüfüs Du Sol, released on Sweat It Out. It entered the ARIA Albums Chart at number one and later went platinum in Australia.

title: Bloom
label: Foreign Family Collective

tracks.t: Until The Sun Needs To Rise

about: The Sydney trio's second studio album, released through Sweat It Out and Sony Music Australia. Like its predecessor it reached number one in Australia, and it contains singles such as You Were Right and Innerbloom.

title: Siamese Dream
label: Virgin
personnel: Billy Corgan – strings, guitar, mellotron, vocals, producer, reissue producer
about: The Smashing Pumpkins' second studio album, produced by Butch Vig and Billy Corgan and issued by Virgin. Its singles included Cherub Rock, Today and Disarm; it reached the Billboard 200 top ten and was certified seven times platinum in the US.

title: The Mirror Conspiracy
label: Eighteenth Street Lounge Music
about: Second studio album from the Washington, D.C. electronic duo Thievery Corporation, written and produced by Rob Garza and Eric Hilton. It blends lounge, trip hop and chillout styles and became the pair's top-selling record in the United States.

about: A collection of forty U2 songs from across the band's catalogue, newly re-recorded in mostly pared-back, acoustic arrangements with the Edge producing. It was issued by Island and Interscope as a companion to Bono's 2022 memoir Surrender.

about: Debut studio album by the Los Angeles indie pop band Foster the People, home to the breakout hit Pumped Up Kicks. An expanded tenth-anniversary deluxe edition titled Torches X followed in November 2021.

about: Bill Withers' second studio album, released on Sussex Records and produced by Withers with his backing musicians. It contains Lean on Me, which topped the US pop and R&B charts, and Use Me, which reached number two.

about: Fourth studio album by the British rock band Dire Straits, produced by Mark Knopfler. It is known for long, expansive tracks such as the opener Telegraph Road, along with the single Private Investigations.

title: Live At The Apollo
label: DOL

tracks.t: I Love You, Yes I Do

about: Concert recording of James Brown and the Famous Flames, captured at Harlem's Apollo Theater in October 1962 and issued by King Records. It became a major commercial success and is widely ranked among the finest live albums.

Thank You For Talkin' To Me Africa

about: Fifth studio album by Sly and the Family Stone, released by Epic. Darker and murkier than the band's earlier work, it topped the Billboard album chart and includes the number-one single Family Affair.

about: Eleventh studio album by Everything but the Girl and their first in almost 24 years, self-produced by Ben Watt and Tracey Thorn. It reached number three in the UK, the duo's highest album placing there.

title: Confessions
label: Arista
about: Usher's fourth studio album, released on Arista and LaFace. Driven by hits such as Yeah!, Burn and My Boo, it became one of the best-selling albums of the century and won a Grammy.

title: Ready To Die
label: Bad Boy Entertainment
about: Debut studio album by the Brooklyn rapper the Notorious B.I.G., released on Bad Boy Records. Featuring Juicy and Big Poppa, it helped revive East Coast hip hop and is regarded as a genre landmark.

title: Today & Tomorrow
label: Forever Living Originals
about: Ninth studio album by Sault, a short set mixing funk with punk energy, produced by Inflo. It was issued alongside four other releases as a time-limited free download, then reached streaming services on 12 November 2022.

title: Desperado
label: Asylum Records
about: Second studio album by the Eagles, a concept record built around Old West outlaws. Though modest on release, its title song and Tequila Sunrise became enduring favourites.

title: Mommy

about: Third studio album by the Nashville punk band Be Your Own Pet, released on Third Man Records after the group reunited. It was their first new music since 2008 and drew strong reviews.

about: 11 is a funk and neo soul album by Sault, part of a surprise batch of five records offered free for a few days in November 2022. It later took the Ivor Novello Award for Best Album in 2023.

about: The first full-length record from New York band Interpol, issued by Matador Records and produced by Peter Katis. Recorded in Connecticut in late 2001, it became a landmark of the post-punk revival and eventually earned gold certifications in the US and UK.

about: Tears for Fears' first album, a synth-pop record produced by Chris Hughes and Ross Cullum for Mercury. It climbed to the top of the UK chart and contains the singles Mad World, Change and Pale Shelter.

about: Santi White's first album, issued under her original stage name Santogold, blends new wave, electro, reggae and indie rock. Recorded in New York with producers including Diplo and Switch, it spawned the singles Creator, L.E.S. Artistes and Lights Out.

title: Back To Black
label: Universal Republic Records
about: Amy Winehouse's second and last studio record, produced by Mark Ronson and Salaam Remi for Island. It won the Grammy for Best Pop Vocal Album and has sold around 20 million copies worldwide.

title: Rubber Soul
label: Parlophone
about: The Beatles' sixth album, produced by George Martin and released on Parlophone in December 1965. It marked a move toward more mature songwriting and studio experimentation.

title: Off The Wall
label: Epic
about: Michael Jackson's first Epic release and first collaboration with producer Quincy Jones. Mixing disco, funk and pop, it yielded two number-one singles and has sold more than 20 million copies globally.

title: Ziggy Stardust And The Spiders From Mars (The Motion Picture Soundtrack)

about: A concert recording of David Bowie's final Ziggy Stardust show at London's Hammersmith Odeon on 3 July 1973. Issued by RCA a decade later, it served as the soundtrack to D. A. Pennebaker's documentary film of the performance.

title: A Charlie Brown Christmas
label: Fantasy
about: The Vince Guaraldi Trio's jazz score for the animated television special A Charlie Brown Christmas, issued by Fantasy Records. Recorded in San Francisco, it includes Linus and Lucy and Christmas Time Is Here and became a perennial holiday favorite.

label: Apple Records

about: The Beatles' eleventh album, issued on Apple in September 1969 and produced by George Martin. It was the final record the band made together, although Let It Be came out afterwards.

about: The third album from electronic duo Bob Moses, Tom Howie and Jimmy Vallance, released through Domino and Astralwerks. Reviewers noted a larger, somewhat darker sound than on their earlier pop-leaning dance records.

title: The Land Is Inhospitable And So Are We

about: Mitski's seventh album, released on Dead Oceans and produced by Patrick Hyland. Drawing on country, folk and orchestral pop and recorded in Nashville and Los Angeles, it received widespread critical acclaim.

tracks.t: (The Angels Wanna Wear My) Red Shoes
Waiting For The End Of The World

about: Elvis Costello's first album, produced by Nick Lowe and issued by Stiff Records in the UK, with a later Columbia release in the US. It features Alison and Less Than Zero and was eventually certified platinum in America.

title: One Of These Nights
label: Asylum Records
personnel: Bernie Leadon – vocals, guitar, banjo, mandolin, steel guitar
Don Felder – vocals, guitar, slide guitar
about: The Eagles' fourth album, produced by Bill Szymczyk for Asylum, gave the band its first number-one record in the US. It contains Lyin' Eyes and Take It to the Limit and was the last with founding guitarist Bernie Leadon.

title: Betty Davis
label: Light In The Attic

tracks.t: If I'm In Luck I Might Get Picked Up
Steppin In Her I. Miller Shoes

about: Funk singer Betty Davis's first album, produced by Greg Errico and recorded in San Francisco for Just Sunshine Records. All eight songs were her own compositions, and the record was reissued by Light in the Attic in 2007.

title: 1989 (Taylor's Version)
label: Republic Records

tracks.t: All You Had To Do Was Stay (Taylor's Version)
How You Get The Girl (Taylor's Version)
Say Don't Go (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
Now That We Don't Talk (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
Is It Over Now? (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)

about: Taylor Swift's re-recording of her 2014 album 1989, released by Republic and adding five previously unreleased vault tracks. It debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 and drew strong reviews.

title: 1989 (Taylor's Version)
label: Republic Records

tracks.t: All You Had To Do Was Stay (Taylor's Version)
How You Get The Girl (Taylor's Version)
Say Don't Go (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
Now That We Don't Talk (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
Is It Over Now? (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)

about: Taylor Swift's re-recording of her 2014 album 1989, released by Republic and adding five previously unreleased vault tracks. It debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 and drew strong reviews.

title: Sounds From The Thievery Hi-Fi
label: Primary Wave Music

tracks.t: Scene At The Open Air Market

about: The first full-length record by the Washington, D.C. electronic duo Thievery Corporation, issued in Germany in 1996 and in the United States by ESL Music in 1997. It mixes dub, bossa nova, hip-hop and lounge sampling, with vocal contributions from Pam Bricker and Bebel Gilberto.

title: To Pimp A Butterfly
label: Top Dawg Entertainment
about: Kendrick Lamar's third studio record, put out by Top Dawg, Aftermath and Interscope. Drawing heavily on jazz, funk and spoken word, with producers such as Sounwave, Terrace Martin and Thundercat, it tackles race and fame in America and earned enormous critical praise.

title: Zooropa
label: Island Records

tracks.t: Daddy's Gonna Pay For Your Crashed Car
Some Days Are Better Than Others

about: U2's eighth studio album, cut in Dublin during a pause in the Zoo TV Tour and produced by Flood, Brian Eno and the Edge. Originally planned as an EP, it grew into an experimental electronic-leaning LP that topped many charts and won a Grammy for Best Alternative Music Album.

title: Desire, I Want To Turn Into You
label: Perpetual Novice
about: Caroline Polachek's fourth studio album counting her earlier aliases, released on her own Perpetual Novice imprint and made mostly with producer Danny L Harle. The art-pop record drew near-universal acclaim from critics and picked up a Grammy nomination for its engineering.

title: Chronicles Of A Diamond
label: ATO Records
about: The second studio album by Austin soul band Black Pumas, issued by ATO Records and produced by Adrian Quesada. Its single More Than a Love Song reached number one on Billboard's Adult Alternative Airplay chart, and reviews were generally favourable.

title: All That Was East Is West Of Me Now
label: Anti-
about: The fifth solo studio album by Irish singer-songwriter Glen Hansard, produced by Dave Odlum and released on Anti-. Critics responded positively to the record, which runs a little over 42 minutes.

title: Extension Of A Man
label: ATCO Records

tracks.t: I Love The Lord; He Heard My Cry (Parts I & II)
I Love You More Than You'll Ever Know

about: Donny Hathaway's last solo studio album, released by Atco and produced by Arif Mardin. Blending soul with orchestral and jazz elements, it includes the singles Love, Love, Love and Come Little Children and features players such as Stanley Clarke.

title: Nashville Skyline
label: Columbia

tracks.t: Tell Me That It Isn't True
Tonight I'll Be Staying Here With You

about: Bob Dylan's ninth studio album, recorded in Nashville with producer Bob Johnston, saw him fully embrace country music with a noticeably softer singing voice. It reached the top three in the US, topped the UK chart and included the hit Lay Lady Lay.

title: Hard Promises
label: Backstreet Records
personnel: Mike Campbell – acoustic guitar, electric guitar, autoharp, accordion, harmonium, bass guitar

tracks.t: A Woman In Love (It's Not Me)
You Can Still Change Your Mind

about: The fourth studio album by Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers, first released in 1981 rather than 1993. Its release was held up by Petty's public fight with MCA over the record's retail price, and it was the final full album with bassist Ron Blair in the original lineup.

title: Aftermath
label: London Records
personnel: Brian Jones – dulcimer, sitar, guitar, marimba, bells, piano, organ, harpsichord
Bill Wyman – bass, marimba, bells, piano, organ, harpsichord
Charlie Watts – drums, marimba, bells, percussion
Jack Nitzsche – percussion, piano, organ, harpsichord
about: The Rolling Stones' fourth British studio album and the first made up entirely of Jagger and Richards compositions. The UK version spent eight weeks at number one, while the shorter American edition, issued that summer, swapped several tracks for Paint It Black.

title: Johnny Cash At San Quentin
label: Columbia
about: A concert recording Johnny Cash made at San Quentin State Prison in California in February 1969, following his earlier Folsom Prison album. It was a major commercial hit and contains A Boy Named Sue, which won him a Grammy.

title: Records
label: Atlantic
personnel: Lou Gramm - vocals, percussion Mick Jones - guitar, bass, piano, vocals Ian McDonald - guitar, horns, keyboards, vocals
Dennis Elliott - drums Al Greenwood - keyboards, synthesizer Ed Gagliardi, Rick Wills - bass, vocals

tracks.t: Waiting For A Girl Like You

about: A greatest-hits collection by Foreigner on Atlantic, gathering songs from the band's first four albums. It became one of the group's biggest sellers and has been certified seven times platinum in the United States.

title: Bella Donna
label: Modern Records
about: Stevie Nicks' first solo studio album, made while she remained a member of Fleetwood Mac. It climbed to number one on the Billboard 200 within weeks, went multi-platinum and yielded four hit singles.

title: Spirit In The Dark
label: Atlantic

tracks.t: The Thrill Is Gone (From Yesterday's Kiss)
That's All I Want From You

about: An Atlantic Records album by Aretha Franklin that was well reviewed but sold less than her preceding releases. Its lead single, Don't Play That Song (You Lied), went to number one on the R&B chart and sold over a million copies.

title: Dead Club City
label: Sony Music
about: The fourth studio album by English rock band Nothing but Thieves, released through Sony Music UK. Built around a concept of characters in a fictional city and leaning into electropop and funk, it became their first number-one album in the UK.

title: For Those In Love
label: EmArcy

tracks.t: I Get A Kick Out Of You
You Don't Know What Love Is

about: A vocal jazz album by Dinah Washington on EmArcy, recorded over three days in March 1955. The arrangements were written by a young Quincy Jones, and the set focuses on ballads and standards in a small-group setting.

title: In Person
label: Columbia
about: A live album by Ray Charles on Atlantic, captured at an outdoor concert in Atlanta in May 1959 and produced by Zenas Sears. It was later inducted into the Grammy Hall of Fame.

title: Embrace
label: Counter Records
about: The fourth album by Roosevelt, the project of German producer and multi-instrumentalist Marius Lauber, released on Counter Records/Ninja Tune as the successor to Polydans. Lauber wrote, played and produced it himself, partly while touring, reflecting on adulthood after turning 30.

title: Substance
label: Factory
personnel: Bernard Sumner - vocals, guitar Peter Hook - bass Stephen Morris - drums
about: A Factory Records double compilation gathering New Order's singles in their 12-inch forms along with B-sides and the new single True Faith. It sold more than a million copies and is often considered the band's most popular release.

title: Matador
label: Impex Records
personnel: Kenny Dorham - trumpet Jackie McLean - alto saxophone Bobby Timmons - piano
about: A jazz album by trumpeter Kenny Dorham on United Artists, produced by Alan Douglas and recorded in New York in April 1962. Dorham is joined by Jackie McLean on alto saxophone, Bobby Timmons on piano, Teddy Smith on bass and J.C. Moses on drums.

title: Aretha Arrives
label: Atlantic
personnel: Spooner Oldham – piano, organ, electric piano
Truman Thomas – piano, organ, electric piano
about: Aretha Franklin's second album for Atlantic, recorded while she was recovering from an elbow injury. Its single Baby I Love You reached number one on the R&B chart and the top five of the Hot 100.

title: Come A Little Closer
label: Chess
personnel: The William Smith Singers – backing vocals

tracks.t: You Give Me What I Want

about: An Etta James album on Chess, produced by Gabriel Mekler, made during a period when she was struggling with addiction and attending sessions from rehab. It reached number 47 on Billboard's R&B albums chart.

title: Is It Love Or Desire
label: Light In The Attic
about: Betty Davis recorded this funk album in 1976 at Studio in the Country in Louisiana, but it was shelved after a dispute with her label. It finally came out in 2009 through Light in the Attic Records, more than three decades later.

title: With A Little Help From My Friends
label: A&M Records
personnel: Joe Cocker - vocals Jimmy Page - guitar Steve Winwood - organ

tracks.t: Do I Still Figure In Your Life?
With A Little Help From My Friends

about: Joe Cocker's first studio album, released on Regal Zonophone in the UK and A&M in the US. It went gold in America, and his reworking of the Beatles' title song became a signature hit, later used as the theme of The Wonder Years.

title: Odetta At Carnegie Hall
label: Vanguard

tracks.t: I'm Going Back To The Red Clay Country
When I Was A Young Girl
Joshua Fought The Battle Of Jericho
No More Auction Block For Me
Sometimes I Feel Like A Motherless Child
Ain't No Grave Can Hold My Body Down

about: A Vanguard live album by folk singer Odetta, recorded at Carnegie Hall in April 1960 and issued later that year. It mixes folk songs and blues and has since gone out of print, though some tracks resurfaced on later anthologies.

title: Dazzle Ships
label: Virgin
personnel: Orchestral Manoeuvres In The Dark – producer

tracks.t: Of All The Things We've Made

about: The fourth studio album by Orchestral Manoeuvres in the Dark, built from musique concrete collages and shortwave radio sounds exploring Cold War themes. Despite reaching number five in the UK it was viewed as a commercial setback at the time, but later gained cult status.

title: Hot Buttered Soul
label: Enterprise

tracks.t: By The Time I Get To Phoenix

about: Isaac Hayes' second studio album, recorded for Stax's Enterprise imprint with the Bar-Kays. It consists of just four long tracks, including extended takes on Walk On By and By the Time I Get to Phoenix, and topped the R&B album chart.

title: Black Acid Soul
label: Foundation Music
about: The debut album by Lady Blackbird, the stage name of singer Marley Munroe, made with producer Chris Seefried, who also suggested its title. It presents her voice in sparse jazz and soul arrangements, with physical editions following in early 2022.

title: Chunga's Revenge
label: Bizarre Records

tracks.t: Would You Go All The Way?
Rudy Wants To Buy Yez A Drink

about: Issued on Zappa's Bizarre label through Reprise, this eclectic record mixes guitar instrumentals, jazz passages, pop songs and live improvisation drawn from 1969-70 sessions. It was the first Zappa album to feature former Turtles singers Mark Volman and Howard Kaylan.

title: Benefit
label: Chrysalis

tracks.t: With You There To Help Me
Alive And Well And Living In
For Michael Collins, Jeffrey And Me

about: The British rock band's third studio album, released in spring 1970. It marked the arrival of keyboard player John Evan on a Tull record and was the final one with bassist Glenn Cornick.

title: Duty Now For The Future
label: Warner Records

tracks.t: The Day My Baby Gave Me A Surprize

about: Devo's second studio album, produced by Ken Scott for Warner Bros. and recorded at Chateau Recorders in Hollywood between late 1978 and early 1979. It combined songs the band had written in the mid-1970s with newer material.

title: Lifes Rich Pageant
label: I.R.S. Records

tracks.t: What If We Give It Away?

about: R.E.M.'s fourth studio album, produced by Don Gehman and issued by I.R.S. Records. It reached number 21 in the US, making it the band's best-selling American release up to that point.

title: At Folsom Prison
label: Legacy

tracks.t: Flushed From The Bathroom Of Your Heart

about: Johnny Cash's first live album, taped at California's Folsom State Prison in January 1968 and released by Columbia. It topped the country albums chart, revitalised his career and was eventually certified triple platinum.

title: Roberta Flack
label: Atlantic

tracks.t: If Ever I See You Again
Knowing That We're Made For Each Other

about: A self-titled Atlantic Records album from 1978. It is counted as Flack's seventh solo studio album, or her eighth if her 1972 duet album with Donny Hathaway is included.

title: Coat Of Many Colors
label: RCA Victor

tracks.t: She Never Met A Man (She Didn't Like)

about: Dolly Parton's eighth solo studio album, released by RCA Victor. It climbed to number 7 on the Billboard country albums chart and earned a CMA Album of the Year nomination in 1972.

title: I/O (Bright-Side Mixes)
label: Real World Records
about: Gabriel's tenth studio album and his first set of new original songs since 2002. The Bright-Side version was mixed by Mark Stent; songs were rolled out as singles timed to full and new moons before the full album appeared with both mixes.

title: I/O (Dark-Side Mixes)
label: Real World Records
about: The alternative presentation of Gabriel's tenth studio album, with mixes by Tchad Blake. Gabriel opted to release this version alongside the Bright-Side mixes rather than choose one, and physical editions carry both.

title: Dusty
label: Premium Cool Records

tracks.t: I Wish I'd Never Loved You
Do Re Me (Forget About The Do And Think About Me)
I Just Don't Know What To Do With Myself

about: Springfield's second album issued in the United States, released by Philips. It gathered tracks from her UK debut LP, UK singles and EPs, plus new New York recordings, and included All Cried Out and I Just Don't Know What to Do with Myself.

title: Blow Up
label: Impex Records
personnel: Takashi Mizuhashi - Bass Isao Suzuki - Bass, Cello George Otsuka - Drums Kunihiko Sugano - Piano
about: A Japanese jazz record by bassist and cellist Isao Suzuki's trio and quartet, recorded at Aoi Studio in Tokyo in March 1973. It was issued by the audiophile label Three Blind Mice as catalogue number TBM-15.

title: Midnight Sugar
label: Isao Fukui - Bass
personnel: Tetsujiro Obara - Drums Tsuyoshi Yamamoto - Piano

tracks.t: I'm A Fool To Want You

about: Pianist Tsuyoshi Yamamoto's first album as a trio leader, recorded at Aoi Studio in Tokyo on 1 March 1974. It appeared on the Three Blind Mice label (TBM-23) and has become a frequently reissued audiophile favourite.

title: Misty
label: Impex Records
personnel: Isao Fukui - Bass Tetsujiro Obara - Drums Tsuyoshi Yamamoto - Piano

tracks.t: I Didn't Know What Time It Was

about: A 1974 piano trio album led by Tsuyoshi Yamamoto, released by Three Blind Mice as TBM-30. It followed Midnight Sugar in the label's catalogue and is named after the Tokyo jazz club where the trio played.

title: Jailbreak
label: Mercury
personnel: Phil Lynott – bass, acoustic guitar, vocals

tracks.t: The Boys Are Back In Town

about: Thin Lizzy's sixth studio album, released by Vertigo in Britain and Mercury in America. It gave the Irish band its US breakthrough, going gold there on the strength of The Boys Are Back in Town.

title: Broken Machine
label: RCA
personnel: Conor Mason - vocals Joe Langridge-Brown - guitar, percussion Dominic Craik - guitar, percussion Phil Blake - bass James Price - drums
about: The second studio album by the English rock band Nothing but Thieves, released in September 2017.

title: Diamonds And Pearls
label: NPG Records
personnel: The New Power Generation – producer, composed by, performer
Damon Dickson – performer, backing vocals, percussion
Kirk Johnson – performer, backing vocals, percussion
Sonny T. – performer, bass, backing vocals
Rosie Gaines – performer, lead vocals, sampler, organ
Tony M. – performer, rap, backing vocals
Levi Seacer, Jr. – performer, rhythm guitar, backing vocals

tracks.t: Live 4 Love (Last Words From The Cockpit)

about: Prince's thirteenth studio album, released in the US on 1 October 1991 and abroad shortly after. It was the first album to showcase his backing band, the New Power Generation.

title: Mosquito
label: Interscope Records
personnel: Brian Chase – drums, cymbal, percussion, vocals
Nick Zinner – guitar, bass, keyboards, vocals
about: The fourth studio album by the New York indie rock trio Yeah Yeah Yeahs, released in April 2013, with UK and US releases following a few days later.

title: Two Tribes (Annihilation)
label: Island Records
about: The original 12-inch version of the band's Cold War-themed hit, issued by ZTT. It opens with an air-raid siren and uses narration by Patrick Allen taken from a public information film about nuclear attack.

title: White People And The Damage Done
label: Alternative Tentacles
about: The second studio album by Jello Biafra and the Guantanamo School of Medicine, released on Alternative Tentacles. The roughly 77-minute hardcore and surf-punk record was written by Biafra and closes with several remixes and extended versions.

title: Saviors
label: Reprise Records

tracks.t: The American Dream Is Killing Me
Strange Days Are Here To Stay

about: Green Day's fourteenth studio album, issued by Reprise Records in January 2024. It was promoted by five singles and was generally well received by critics.

title: Nightbirds
label: Epic
personnel: Patti LaBelle, Nona Hendryx & Sarah Dash - lead and backing vocals Allen Toussaint - keyboards, percussion, guitar
Art Neville - organ George Porter Jr., Walter Payton - bass. James "Budd" Ellison - piano Smokey Johnson, Herman Ernest III- drums Leo Nocentelli, Rev
Edward Levone Batts - guitar Earl Turbinton - alto saxophone, soprano saxophone, clarinet

tracks.t: What Can I Do For You?

about: Labelle's fourth studio album, produced by Allen Toussaint in New Orleans and blending funk, soul and rock. Driven by the hit Lady Marmalade, it became the trio's biggest seller and anticipated the disco era.

title: The Lion And The Cobra
label: Ensign
personnel: Sinéad O'Connor – producer, electric guitar, vocals
Rob Dean – acoustic guitar, electric guitar

tracks.t: Just Like U Said It Would B

about: Sinead O'Connor's first studio album, recorded while she was heavily pregnant. It won critical praise, reached number 27 in Britain and 36 in the US, and was certified gold or platinum in several countries.

title: The Man-Machine
label: Kling Klang
personnel: Florian Schneider – concept by, producer, vocoder, synthesizer, electronics
Ralf Hütter – concept by, producer, cover, voice, vocoder, synthesizer, keyboards, sequenced by, electronics
about: Kraftwerk's seventh studio album, pairing tighter, more danceable songwriting with themes about technology and the relationship between people and machines. It is widely seen as a major influence on synth-pop and new wave.

title: Ray Charles
label: Analogue
about: Ray Charles's first full-length album for Atlantic Records, collecting his mid-1950s rhythm and blues singles. It is also known by the title Hallelujah I Love Her So.

title: The Life And Times Of Country Joe And The Fish From Haight-Ashbury To Woodstock
label: Vanguard
personnel: Country Joe McDonald - vocals, guitar, tambourine, harmonica Barry Melton - guitar, vocals, bass
David Cohen - guitar, organ Bruce Barthol - bass, harmonica. Gary "Chicken" Hirsh - drums
about: A 1971 Vanguard retrospective of the San Francisco psychedelic band Country Joe and the Fish, gathering recordings from their studio albums and live performances, including material associated with Woodstock.

title: London Sessions
label: DFA
personnel: David Scott Stone – guitar, percussion, vocals
Gavin Russom – synth, keyboards, percussion, vocals

tracks.t: Daft Punk Is Playing At My House

about: A set of LCD Soundsystem songs recorded live in a London studio during the This Is Happening era and released in 2010.

title: I Just Can't Stop It
label: Rhino Records

tracks.t: Can't Get Used To Losing You

about: The first studio album by the Birmingham two-tone ska band known in the US as the English Beat, released on Go-Feet in 1980. It collected hits such as Mirror in the Bathroom and Hands Off...She's Mine.

title: Closer
label: Rhino Records
about: Joy Division's second and last studio album, produced by Martin Hannett for Factory Records. It came out two months after singer Ian Curtis died and is regarded as a landmark of post-punk.

title: Tower Of Power
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Emilio Castillo – producer, tenor saxophone, vocals
Greg Adams – conductor, trumpet, flugelhorn, vocals
Stephen Kupka – baritone saxophone, oboe, vocals
Lenny Pickett – tenor saxophone, flute, clarinet, vocals
Mic Gillette – trumpet, trombone, flugelhorn, baritone horn, vocals

tracks.t: Will I Ever Find A Love?
Get Yo' Feet Back On The Ground

about: The Oakland soul and funk band's third LP, issued on Warner Bros., introduced Lenny Williams as lead singer and Lenny Pickett on saxophone. It went gold, reached the top 15 of the Billboard album chart, and featured the hit So Very Hard to Go along with What Is Hip?.

title: Tidal
label: Clean Slate
about: Fiona Apple's first album, produced by Andrew Slater, launched her career with the singles Shadowboxer, Sleep to Dream and Criminal. It peaked at number 15 in the US, was certified triple platinum, and Criminal earned her a Grammy for Best Female Rock Vocal Performance.

title: Core
label: Atlantic
about: Stone Temple Pilots' first record, produced by Brendan O'Brien for Atlantic, made the band a major force in early-1990s alternative rock. Driven by Sex Type Thing, Plush and Creep, it climbed to number 3 on the Billboard 200 and eventually sold over eight million copies in the US.

title: Fuckin' Frenchies
label: Radio Blast Recordings
personnel: François Lemos (aka Mimos) - vocals Buzz - bass
Babouche, Xavier R - drums Olivier D (aka OD) - guitar
about: An early full-length by the French garage-punk group T.V. Killers, released in Europe after their debut Adrenalin Fix. Several of its songs were later gathered on the 1999 American compilation Playin' Bad Music Since '92.

title: Act II: Cowboy Carter
label: Parkwood Entertainment
about: Beyoncé's eighth studio album and the second part of a planned trilogy after Renaissance explores country and Americana traditions. It topped the Billboard 200 and the country albums chart, spawned the chart-topping Texas Hold 'Em, and won Album of the Year and Best Country Album at the Grammys.

title: Lovesexy
label: Warner Records
about: Prince's tenth studio album, recorded largely at Paisley Park over a few weeks around the turn of 1988, centers on spirituality and the struggle between good and evil. It reached number 1 in the UK and several European countries, number 11 in the US, and yielded Alphabet St. as a single.

title: Cameosis
label: Chocolate City
personnel: Larry Blackmon - lead vocals, drums, percussion Gregory Johnson - keyboards, guitar, vocals
Aaron Mills - bass, vocals Thomas 'T.C.' Campbell - piano, guitar, synthesizer Anthony Lockett - guitar, vocals
Arnett Leftenant - saxophone, vocals Nathan Leftenant - trumpet, vocals
Jeryl Bright - trombone Tomi Jenkins, Wayne Cooper - vocals
about: The fifth album by funk group Cameo, produced by Larry Blackmon for Chocolate City, became their first to top the R&B albums chart. It was certified gold and included the R&B hits Shake Your Pants and We're Goin' Out Tonight.

title: Stand!
label: Epic

tracks.t: I Want To Take You Higher
You Can Make It If You Try

about: Written, arranged and produced by Sly Stone, the band's fourth album became their commercial breakthrough on Epic. It contains the number-one single Everyday People plus Stand! and I Want to Take You Higher, stayed on the charts for nearly two years, and was later certified platinum.

title: Captain Fantastic And The Brown Dirt Cowboy
label: MCA Records

tracks.t: Captain Fantastic And The Brown Dirt Cowboy
Tell Me When The Whistle Blows
We All Fall In Love Sometimes

about: Elton John's ninth studio album is an autobiographical concept record tracing his and lyricist Bernie Taupin's struggling early years in London. It was the first album ever to enter the Billboard 200 at number one, held the top spot for seven weeks, and featured the single Someone Saved My Life Tonight.

title: Pow Pow (Idjut Boys Remix)
label: DFA
about: A limited 12-inch vinyl release on DFA pairing an Idjut Boys remix of the 2010 LCD Soundsystem track Pow Pow with a Rub-N-Tug remix of Too Much Love on the flip side.

title: Tango In The Night
label: Warner Bros. Records
about: Fleetwood Mac's fourteenth studio album, produced by Lindsey Buckingham and Richard Dashut, was the last with the classic Rumours-era lineup until 1997. It sold more than 15 million copies, topped the UK chart, and produced the hits Big Love, Seven Wonders, Little Lies and Everywhere.

title: Rated R
label: Interscope Records

tracks.t: Feel Good Hit Of The Summer
The Lost Art Of Keeping A Secret
I Think I Lost My Headache

about: The second Queens of the Stone Age album, co-produced by Josh Homme and Chris Goss, was their first for Interscope and the first with Nick Oliveri and Mark Lanegan on board. Widely praised, it became the band's breakthrough and included The Lost Art of Keeping a Secret and Feel Good Hit of the Summer.

title: I Don't Know A Thing About Love
label: Legacy
personnel: Bobby Terry – acoustic guitar, electric banjo
Jim "Moose" Brown – piano, synthesizer, organ, electric piano

tracks.t: Excuse Me (I Think I've Got A Heartache)
I Don't Know A Thing About Love

about: Produced by Buddy Cannon for Legacy, this album has Willie Nelson interpreting ten songs by Nashville songwriter Harlan Howard, including the lead single Busted. Critics responded very favorably to the collection.

title: Mirage
label: Warner Records
personnel: Lindsey Buckingham – guitar, vocals, keyboards, producer
about: Fleetwood Mac's thirteenth studio album, begun at a French chateau studio, returned to a more accessible soft rock sound after the experimental Tusk. It spent five weeks at number one in the US, went double platinum, and featured Hold Me and Gypsy.

title: Bye Bye Bayou
label: DFA
about: A standalone single on DFA in which LCD Soundsystem cover a 1980 Alan Vega song, issued as a vinyl release tied to a Record Store Day spin-off event. The B-side carries an a cappella version of the track.

title: Only God Was Above Us
label: Columbia
about: Vampire Weekend's fifth album, co-produced by Ezra Koenig and Ariel Rechtshaid, takes its title from a 1988 New York tabloid headline about an airliner accident. It drew strong reviews and was preceded by the singles Capricorn, Gen-X Cops, Classical and Mary Boone.

title: Rage Against The Machine
label: Epic Associated
about: The Los Angeles band's first album fused rap vocals, heavy riffs and radical left-wing politics, with a cover showing the 1963 self-immolation of a Vietnamese monk. Singles included Killing in the Name and Bullet in the Head, and the record went multi-platinum in the US, UK and Australia.

title: Outlandos D'Amour
label: A&M Records
about: The Police's self-produced first album on A&M blended punk energy with reggae rhythms. It contains Roxanne, Can't Stand Losing You and So Lonely, reached number 6 in the UK, and went platinum in Britain and the United States.

title: Rough Cut
label: Island Records

tracks.t: I Heard It Through The Grapevine (Rough Mix)

about: A limited Record Store Day vinyl from Island that presents an alternative take on The Slits' 1979 album Cut, built from Dennis Bovell's rough mixes. It substitutes a demo for one track and adds the group's cover of I Heard It Through the Grapevine.

title: Peter Gabriel (Scratch)
label: Atlantic

tracks.t: A Wonderful Day In A One-Way World

about: Peter Gabriel's second solo album, nicknamed Scratch after its Hipgnosis cover art, was produced by Robert Fripp with a deliberately spare sound. It reached the UK top 10 and was led by the single D.I.Y.

title: Dark Matter
label: Republic Records
about: Pearl Jam's twelfth studio album was produced by Andrew Watt, largely at Shangri-La in Malibu. Well received by critics, it entered the Billboard 200 at number 5, earned Grammy nominations, and was drummer Matt Cameron's final album with the group.

title: Kerplunk!
label: Reprise Records
about: Green Day's second album, released on the independent Lookout label, was their first with drummer Tre Cool. Its pop-punk songs, including an early version of Welcome to Paradise, built a strong underground following, and it eventually went platinum in the US.

title: Paris (October 1992)
label: Fiction Records
about: Recorded at Le Zenith in Paris over three nights in October 1992 during the Wish tour, this concert album was released alongside the companion live set Show. It draws largely on older and less obvious songs from The Cure's catalogue.

title: Couldn't Stand The Weather
label: Epic
personnel: Stevie Ray Vaughan – producer, vocals, guitar

tracks.t: The Things (That) I Used To Do

about: The second album by Stevie Ray Vaughan and Double Trouble was cut at New York's Power Station with John Hammond as executive producer. Featuring the title track, Cold Shot and a cover of Voodoo Child (Slight Return), it sold strongly and was later certified double platinum.

title: Rebel Yell
label: Chrysalis
personnel: Steve Stevens – guitar, keyboards, synthesizer, bass
about: Billy Idol's second solo album, produced by Keith Forsey and recorded in New York, mixed new wave with hard rock. It reached number 6 in the US, went double platinum, and produced the hits Rebel Yell, Eyes Without a Face and Flesh for Fantasy.

title: Lucky For You
label: Sub Pop
about: Bully's fourth album, released by Sub Pop and produced by JT Daly, includes the single Days Move Slow and a duet with Soccer Mommy. It earned generally favorable reviews and appeared high on several year-end lists for 2023.

title: St. Vincent
label: Loma Vista
about: Annie Clark's fourth solo album as St. Vincent, produced by John Congleton, was issued by Loma Vista and Republic, with an expanded deluxe edition following in 2015. It won the Grammy for Best Alternative Music Album.

title: Country Life
label: Island Records
about: Fourth Roxy Music LP, recorded at AIR London in mid-1974 and co-produced by John Punter with the band. It climbed to number 3 in Britain and became the group's first US top 40 album, while its provocative cover photo was censored in several markets.

title: Songs of Innocence
label: Interscope Records

tracks.t: California (There Is No End To Love)
This Is Where You Can Reach Me Now

about: U2's thirteenth studio record, produced mainly by Danger Mouse, looks back on the members' Irish adolescence in the 1970s. Apple pushed it free to every iTunes account on announcement day, a controversial move, before a physical edition followed in October 2014.

title: Rio
label: EMI
about: Duran Duran's second album, produced by Colin Thurston at AIR Studios in London and issued by EMI. Driven by singles such as Hungry Like the Wolf, Save a Prayer and the title song, it reached number 2 in the UK and, in remixed form, the US top ten.

title: Rastaman Vibration
label: Island Records
personnel: Tyrone Downie – keyboards, bass, percussion, backing vocals
Bob Marley – lead vocals, rhythm guitar, acoustic guitar, percussion
Aston "Family Man" Barrett – bass, guitar, percussion
Earl Smith – lead guitar, rhythm guitar, percussion
about: Roots reggae set by Bob Marley and the Wailers, cut in Kingston and mixed in Miami, then released on Island. It became their biggest US chart success at the time, peaking at number 8, and contained Roots, Rock, Reggae, Marley's lone Billboard Hot 100 entry.

title: Sugaregg
label: Sub Pop
about: Third full-length by Nashville indie rock act Bully, led by Alicia Bognanno, and their second on Sub Pop. Bognanno co-produced it with John Congleton and Graham Walsh, recording mostly at Pachyderm Studios in Minnesota during 2019.

title: The Tortured Poets Department
label: Republic Records

about: Taylor Swift's eleventh studio record, issued by Republic with an expanded double edition, The Anthology, appearing hours later. Made with Jack Antonoff and Aaron Dessner, it spent 17 weeks atop the Billboard 200 and earned an Album of the Year Grammy nomination.

title: Blond
label: Not On Label (Frank Ocean)
about: Frank Ocean's second studio album, also presented under the spelling Blond, came out on his own Boys Don't Cry imprint one day after the visual project Endless. Initially exclusive to Apple's platforms, it blends R&B with sparse, psychedelic and experimental pop textures.

title: All Born Screaming
label: Total Pleasure Records
about: Seventh St. Vincent album and the first Annie Clark produced entirely by herself, released on her Total Pleasure label. Featuring guests including Dave Grohl and Cate Le Bon, it won the Grammy for Best Alternative Music Album among three awards.

title: Masseduction
label: Loma Vista
about: Fifth St. Vincent record, co-produced by Annie Clark with Jack Antonoff and issued on Loma Vista. Leaning toward glossy electropop and art pop, it became her first US top-ten album and won Grammys for its packaging and title song.

title: Bulky Backside
label: EVERLAND
personnel: Laolu "Akins" Akintobi - drums Berkely "Ike" Jones - guitar Mike "Gbenga" Odumosu - bass
about: Late-period release by the Lagos psychedelic funk trio Blo, appearing after Phase IV as their fifth listed album. By this stage the group had been moving from Afro-rock toward R&B and disco influences.

title: Human After All (Unreleased Remixes)
label: Virgin
about: Collection of reworked tracks from Daft Punk's 2005 album Human After All, first issued only in Japan through Toshiba EMI. Remixers included Soulwax and Justice; a worldwide digital release did not arrive until 2014.

title: Kihnspiracy
label: Beserkley
personnel: Greg Kihn Greg Douglass Larry Lynch Gary Phillips Steve Wright
about: Greg Kihn Band album on Beserkley, produced by Matthew King Kaufman at Fantasy Studios in Berkeley. Its single Jeopardy rose to number 2 on the Hot 100, the band's biggest hit, and the record reached number 15 on the Billboard 200.

title: Rickie Lee Jones
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Rickie Lee Jones – guitar, keyboards, percussion, backing vocals

tracks.t: Weasel And The White Boy's Cool

about: Rickie Lee Jones's first album, produced for Warner Bros. by Lenny Waronker and Russ Titelman, mixing rock, R&B and jazz. Boosted by the hit Chuck E.'s in Love, it reached number 3 in the US, went platinum, and helped her win Best New Artist.

title: A Taste Of Honey
label: Capitol Records
personnel: Perry L. Kibble – backing vocals, keyboards, producer
Donald R. Johnson – backing vocals, drums
Hazel P. Payne – backing vocals, guitar, lead vocals
Janice M. Johnson – backing vocals, bass, lead vocals
about: First album by Los Angeles group A Taste of Honey, produced for Capitol by Fonce and Larry Mizell. It contained the chart-topping disco single Boogie Oogie Oogie and peaked at number 6 on the Billboard 200.

title: Phases And Stages
label: Rhino Records

about: Early country concept record by Willie Nelson, produced by Jerry Wexler at Muscle Shoals for Atlantic. It traces a divorce, giving the woman's view on one side and the man's on the other, and included the country hit Bloody Mary Morning.

title: Butterfly
label: Columbia
about: Mariah Carey's sixth studio album on Columbia, marking a stronger turn toward R&B and hip hop collaborations. It produced five singles, among them Honey, the title song and My All.

title: Orchestral Manoeuvres In The Dark
label: Dindisc
personnel: Andy McCluskey – vocals, bass, keyboards, electronic drums
Paul Humphreys – vocals, keyboards, electronic drums, percussion
about: Debut LP by Liverpool synth-pop duo OMD, recorded in their own studio and released on Dindisc. A re-recorded Messages gave them a first UK hit, and the Peter Saville and Ben Kelly die-cut sleeve won a design award.

title: Orchestral Manoeuvres In The Dark
label: Virgin
personnel: Andy McCluskey – voice, bass, keyboards, percussion, drum programming
Paul Humphreys – voice, keyboards, percussion, drum programming
about: Debut LP by Liverpool synth-pop duo OMD, recorded in their own studio and released on Dindisc. A re-recorded Messages gave them a first UK hit, and the Peter Saville and Ben Kelly die-cut sleeve won a design award.

title: Chapter Two
label: Atlantic

tracks.t: Until It's Time For You To Go

about: Roberta Flack's second Atlantic album, produced by Joel Dorn with King Curtis and recorded in New York. It peaked at number 4 on the R&B albums chart and was later certified gold.

title: Living My Life
label: Island Records
about: Sixth Grace Jones album and the final installment of her Compass Point trilogy in the Bahamas, produced by Chris Blackwell and Alex Sadkin for Island. It reached the UK top 15 and was a top-three hit in New Zealand.

title: Jagged Little Pill
label: Reprise Records
about: Alanis Morissette's international breakthrough, following two Canada-only dance-pop records, written and produced with Glen Ballard for Maverick. An alternative rock blockbuster led by You Oughta Know, it topped the US chart, sold around 33 million copies and won five Grammys.

title: Blue Electric Light
label: Roxie Records

tracks.t: It's Just Another Fine Day (In This Universe Of Love)

about: Lenny Kravitz's twelfth album and first since 2018, self-produced at his studio in the Bahamas and issued via Roxie Records and BMG. Singles included TK421 and Human, and it charted highly in Switzerland and Germany.

title: The Rise And Fall Of A Midwest Princess
label: Amusement Records
about: Chappell Roan's first album, produced mostly by Dan Nigro and released through Amusement and Island. A slow-burning success, it climbed to number 2 in the US in 2024, topped the UK chart, and drew an Album of the Year nomination.

title: Diamond Life
label: Epic

tracks.t: When Am I Going To Make A Living

about: Sade's first album, produced by Robin Millar in London and released on Epic, with a US issue in 1985. Featuring Smooth Operator and Your Love Is King, it won the Brit Award for Best British Album and has sold over ten million copies.

title: The Hissing Of Summer Lawns
label: Asylum Records

tracks.t: In France They Kiss On Main Street

about: Joni Mitchell's seventh studio record, self-produced for Asylum and extending her jazz-leaning direction. It added synthesizers, featured an early use of a recorded sample on The Jungle Line, and reached number 4 in the US.

title: Grow Up
label: Fueled By Ramen
personnel: Jeremy Davis – bass, vocals, keyboards, synthesizer, band
Taylor York – guitar, vocals, keyboards, synthesizer, band, drums, percussion
Hayley Williams – vocals, backing vocals, keyboards, synthesizer, band

tracks.t: Hate To See Your Heart Break

about: Grow Up is a song from Paramore's self-titled 2013 album on Fueled by Ramen, written by Hayley Williams and Taylor York. Although not issued as an official single, it reached the UK Rock chart.

title: Random Album Title
label: Mau5trap Recordings
about: Third Deadmau5 album, released by Mau5trap with Ultra in the US and Ministry of Sound in the UK. A progressive and electro house set including Not Exactly and I Remember with Kaskade, it went gold in Canada and Britain.

title: Amyl & The Sniffers
label: Rough Trade
personnel: Amy Taylor - vocals Bryce Wilson - drums Declan Martins - guitar Gus Romer - bass
about: The Melbourne punk group's first full-length record, produced by Ross Orton. It took the ARIA Award for Best Rock Album in 2019, drew strong critical reviews, and reached the top 25 of the Australian chart while also charting in the UK and Scotland.

title: X's
label: Partisan Records
personnel: Greg Gonzalez – producer, vocals, electric guitar, acoustic guitar
about: The third full-length release by the El Paso dream pop act, produced by Greg Gonzalez and issued on Partisan. Its ten songs draw on slow-dance ballads of the 1970s and 1980s and deal with romance and intimacy; it became the band's best US chart showing, entering the Billboard 200 at number 32.

title: Sonido Cósmico
label: Easy Eye Sound
about: The sixth record by the Ecuadorian-Swiss instrumental guitar duo of brothers Estevan and Alejandro Gutierrez. Dan Auerbach produced it at his Easy Eye studio in Nashville, marking their second project together after El Bueno y el Malo, and critics responded very favourably.

title: Ceremonials
label: Universal Republic Records
about: The band's second album, produced by Paul Epworth and released on Island. It opened at number one in the UK, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand and gave the group its first US top-ten album. Singles included Shake It Out and Spectrum, the latter becoming their first UK chart-topper.

title: Brat
label: Atlantic

tracks.t: I Think About It All The Time

about: Charli XCX's sixth album, issued by Atlantic, leans on harder club and rave sounds inspired by 2000s English party culture. It was among the best-reviewed records of 2024, reached number three in the US, topped charts in the UK and several other countries, and won three Grammy Awards from nine nominations.

title: It's Dark And Hell Is Hot
label: Def Jam
about: DMX's first album, released through Def Jam and Ruff Ryders with production largely by Dame Grease and PK. It entered the Billboard 200 at number one, spawned singles such as Ruff Ryders' Anthem and Get at Me Dog, and was eventually certified four times platinum in the US.

title: Comfort To Me
label: ATO Records
personnel: Amy Taylor - vocals Bryce Wilson - drums Declan Martins - guitar Gus Romer - bass

tracks.t: Don’t Need A Cunt (Like You to Love Me)
Comfort To Me - Live From Williamstown

about: The Australian punk band's second album, co-produced with Dan Luscombe and recorded in Melbourne. It earned wide critical praise, climbed to number two on the ARIA chart, and collected several award nominations, winning the AIR Award for best independent punk release.

title: Loud
label: Def Jam Recordings

tracks.t: Love The Way You Lie (Part II)

about: Rihanna's fifth album, on Def Jam and SRP, returned to brighter dance-pop and Caribbean-tinged R&B. It debuted at number three in the US and reached the top in the UK and Canada. Three singles, including Only Girl (In the World) and S&M, went to number one on the Hot 100.

title: Cargo
label: Mobile Fidelity Sound Lab
personnel: Greg Ham – saxophone, flute, keyboards, vocals
about: The Australian band's second album, produced by Peter McIan and released by CBS and Columbia. It topped the Australian chart, reached number three in the US and the top ten in the UK, and yielded singles including Overkill and It's a Mistake.

title: Songs For The Deaf
label: Interscope Records

tracks.t: You Think I Ain't Worth A Dollar, But I Feel Like A Millionaire

about: Queens of the Stone Age's third album, issued by Interscope, featured Dave Grohl on drums. Highly acclaimed by critics, it produced the singles No One Knows and Go with the Flow, reached the top five in the UK, and became the band's first gold record in the US.

title: MTV Unplugged
label: Rhino Records
personnel: Mary Ramsey – musician, viola, backing vocals
Morgan Fichter – musician, violin, backing vocals
Natalie Merchant – performer, lead vocals, piano
Bill Dillon – musician, acoustic guitar, mandolin, slide guitar
Amanda Kramer – musician, piano, pump organ
Dennis Drew – performer, piano, organ, pump organ
about: An acoustic concert taped in New York in April 1993 for MTV's Unplugged series, released on Elektra. Singer Natalie Merchant left the group before it came out. Its cover of Because the Night became the band's biggest hit, and the album later went triple platinum.

title: Good Girl Gone Bad
label: Def Jam Recordings
about: Rihanna's third album moved her toward pop, dance-pop and R&B and away from her earlier Caribbean style. Led by the global hit Umbrella with Jay-Z, which won a Grammy, it topped charts in the UK and Canada and was later certified seven times platinum in the US.

title: Supposed Former Infatuation Junkie
label: Maverick
about: Alanis Morissette's follow-up to Jagged Little Pill, co-produced with Glen Ballard and shaped by a trip to India. Its looser song structures explore self-examination and spirituality. It opened at number one in the US with record first-week sales for a woman at the time and won a Juno for Album of the Year.

title: Cartoon Darkness
label: Virgin Music Group
personnel: Amy Taylor ("Amyl") - vocals Brycy Wilson - drums Declan Mehtens - guitar Gus Romer - bass

tracks.t: U Should Not Be Doing That

about: The punk band's third album, produced by Nick Launay. It reached number two in Australia and the UK top ten, and went on to sweep major categories at the 2025 ARIA Awards, including Album of the Year and Best Group.

title: 9 to 5 and Odd Jobs
label: Vinyl Me, Parton

tracks.t: The House Of The Rising Sun
But You Know I Love You

about: A Dolly Parton concept record about working life on RCA, built around her theme song for the film 9 to 5, which topped both country and pop charts. The album spent ten weeks at number one on the country albums chart and was certified gold.

title: Walk Right In
label: Gus Cannon - vocals, banjo
personnel: Will Shade - Jug Milton Roby - Washboard

about: An LP recorded for Stax by veteran Memphis jug band musician Gus Cannon, joined by Will Shade on jug and Milton Roby on washboard. It came out after the Rooftop Singers turned his 1920s song Walk Right In into a pop hit.
